jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:### **Position Overview**


The Executive Assistant \& Project Coordinator is a key support role for the President and the broader organization. This position is ideal for someone who naturally takes ownership, follows through, stays organized, and enjoys figuring out what needs to happen next.


You will manage and follow up on the President’s priorities, coordinate smaller projects and business initiatives, communicate with employees and outside partners, and provide administrative and occasional personal\-assistant support.


The successful candidate will not simply wait for the next task. They will **anticipate needs, keep projects moving, identify potential problems, follow up consistently, and close the loop on outstanding items.**


This is a hands\-on position in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. The ability to move comfortably between executive support, project coordination, administrative work, and special assignments is essential.

### **What You'll Do**

#### **Executive Support \& Task Management**

* Manage and maintain a centralized list of the President’s priorities, assignments, commitments, and pending decisions.
* Turn conversations, meetings, emails, and verbal direction into clear action items and deadlines.
* Follow up with employees, vendors, clients, contractors, and other contacts to ensure commitments are completed.
* Keep the President informed of progress, upcoming deadlines, outstanding items, and issues requiring attention.
* Resolve routine matters independently whenever possible.
* Help protect the President’s time by organizing information and bringing forward solutions rather than simply identifying problems.
* Anticipate scheduling, administrative, and logistical needs.

#### **Project Coordination**

* Coordinate smaller projects, business initiatives, facility matters, acquisitions, and special assignments.
* Maintain project timelines, task lists, budgets, purchases, deliverables, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with employees, vendors, clients, contractors, and service providers.
* Request and organize quotes and assist with comparing options and coordinating approvals.
* Schedule meetings, deliveries, installations, service appointments, inspections, and other project activities.
* Track estimates, invoices, receipts, purchases, and change requests.
* Identify delays, risks, and unresolved issues and recommend appropriate next steps.
* Follow projects through completion and ensure closeout items and records are organized.

#### **Administrative Support to the President**

* Manage calendar appointments, meetings, reminders, and scheduling priorities.
* Prepare correspondence, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and meeting materials.
* Organize files, records, communications, and reference materials.
* Prepare for meetings by gathering information, confirming logistics, and documenting follow\-up items.
* Draft and coordinate routine communications on behalf of the President.
* Assist with travel arrangements, reservations, itineraries, and related logistics.
* Handle confidential company, employee, financial, client, and personal information with discretion.

#### **Personal Assistant Support**

* Assist with occasional personal appointments, reservations, purchases, errands, and administrative tasks.
* Help coordinate personal and professional commitments.
* Research products, services, vendors, events, and other requested matters and present organized options.
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and discretion when handling personal or confidential information.

#### **General Administration \& Special Projects**

* Support company\-wide administrative initiatives and special projects.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical records.
* Assist with data entry, document preparation, filing, and other administrative tasks as needed.
* Provide administrative support to other departments when directed by the President.
* Take on additional responsibilities as the company’s needs evolve.


Requirements:### **What We're Looking For**

* **Proactive:** You see what needs to be done and take action without waiting to be reminded.
* **Highly organized:** You can manage multiple projects, deadlines, conversations, and priorities without losing track of details.
* **Accountable:** When you take ownership of something, you follow it through to completion.
* **Resourceful:** You are comfortable researching answers, finding solutions, and figuring things out.
* **A strong communicator:** You communicate clearly, professionally, and consistently.
* **Detail\-oriented:** You catch missing information, deadlines, discrepancies, and potential problems.
* **Discreet:** You understand the importance of confidentiality when working with executive, financial, employee, client, and personal information.
* **Adaptable:** You can shift priorities and remain composed when the day does not go according to plan.
* **Solutions\-oriented:** You don't just bring problems forward — you think through possible solutions and next steps.

### **Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in executive assistance, administrative support, project coordination, office management, or a related role.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong follow\-through and ability to work independently.
* Strong research, documentation, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, calendars, task\-management platforms, and standard business software.
* Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for occasional company\-related errands, appointments, or project needs.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting an owner, President, CEO, or other senior executive.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator \- Overview**

Pixl Sauce is seeking a Project Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone of a high\-output content studio. This role ensures schedules, shoots, handoffs, and deliveries stay aligned across multiple creative and production teams.

This is a fully in\-office role that works closely with internal departments and client\-side partners.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the master production calendar across all content initiatives
* Coordinate schedules, logistics, and resourcing across teams
* Manage timelines, deliverables, and internal handoffs
* Track review cycles, approvals, and final deliveries
* Serve as a central point of communication between internal teams and client\-side stakeholders
* Identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve them
* Help refine workflows as volume and complexity grow

**Ideal Candidate**

* 4\+ years in production or content project coordinator
* Exceptionally organized with strong written communication skills
* Comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Experience working with client\-side teams and approvals
* Proactive, calm, and detail\-oriented
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative, in\-office environment

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

**Commercial Construction Asst. Project Manager/Coordinator**  

**Project Controls and Field Coordination**  

Benefits: Health insurance • Vision insurance • Dental insurance • 401(k) matching • Company car  

**Be the Person Who Connects the Field, Project Manager, and Leadership**
=========================================================================


At BF Construction Inc., successful projects happen because the team is looking ahead, asking the right questions, following through on commitments, and keeping the field and office aligned.  

We are looking for an Assistant Project Manager with commercial construction experience who wants to continue growing toward a Project Manager role.  

  

  

This position works directly with Project Managers, Superintendents, Field Leads, subcontractors, vendors, and Leadership to support active commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.  

  

  

The ideal candidate understands construction, is highly organized and detail\-oriented, follows through consistently, and takes ownership of execution.  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
==================



  

Project Controls and Scheduling  

* Help maintain and drive active project schedules and the company Master Schedule


* Build and maintain one\- and two\-week lookaheads


* Coordinate upcoming work with Project Managers, Superintendents/Field Leads, subcontractors, and vendors


* Identify schedule conflicts, missing information, delays, and sequencing risks


* Confirm completed work and update schedules when field conditions or decisions change



  

Subcontractor, Vendor, and Procurement Coordination  

* Coordinate subcontractors, vendors, manpower, material deliveries, equipment, inspections, access, and logistics


* Track procurement and long\-lead materials


* Follow open commitments through completion and flag missing or unconfirmed dates before they affect production



  

Field Coordination  

* Review field progress, Daily Project Updates, SiteCam photos, and project documentation


* Confirm reported progress aligns with actual field conditions


* Identify incomplete work, missing information, and coordination issues


* Maintain constant communication with Field Leads, including, but not limited to performing weekly project planning meetings



  

Project Documentation and Follow\-Through  

* Review drawings, specifications, Bluebeam markups, RFIs, and submittals


* Track RFIs, submittals, procurement items, change\-order follow\-up, and project action items


* Maintain accurate project records and communicate updates clearly


* Follow assigned actions through completion with detail, consistency, and accountability


**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**
=========================


* This is not a purely administrative support role. The APM is expected to understand the project, stay organized, and actively support planning and execution.


* This is not simply maintaining schedules and project documents. This role requires close attention to detail, accurate follow\-through, and consistent execution from one step to the next.


* This is not a position that waits for the Project Manager or Leadership to identify every issue. The APM should recognize risks, missing information, and upcoming needs early and help drive them through resolution.


**WHAT YOU BRING**
==================


* 3\+ years of commercial construction experience


* Experience as a Project Engineer, Assistant Project Manager, Construction Project Coordinator, or similar construction role


* Ability to read and understand construction plans, specifications, and project documents


* Working knowledge of commercial construction sequencing and project workflow


* Experience with schedules, subcontractors, procurement, RFIs, submittals, and field coordination


* Strong attention to detail with consistent follow\-through and execution


* Ability to manage multiple priorities without losing accuracy or missing commitments


* Clear communication, strong organization, and a problem\-solving mindset


* Desire to grow into a commercial construction Project Manager


**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**
========================


* Commercial tenant improvements, renovations, site work, exterior and/or ground\-up construction


* Smartsheet or comparable scheduling software


* Bluebeam and Procore or comparable construction\-management software


* Microsoft 365, Slack, Dropbox, and field\-documentation systems such as SiteCam


**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================


* Project schedules and documentation remain accurate and current


* Upcoming subcontractors, materials, inspections, and project needs are identified early


* Field progress is accurately reflected in the project plan


* Risks, missing information, and open items are communicated before they affect the schedule


* Commitments and action items are followed through consistently


* Project Managers and Superintendents can rely on the APM for accurate, detailed execution


**HARD REQUIREMENT**
====================


Candidates must have direct commercial construction experience and a working understanding of project schedules, subcontractor coordination, procurement, field conditions, and construction documentation.  

This role is designed for someone who already has a construction foundation and is ready to take on greater project\-management responsibility.  

**CAREER PATH**
===============


**Assistant Project Manager**  **Project Manager**  **Senior Project Manager**  

BF Construction is committed to developing people who want to build a long\-term career in construction project management. You will work directly with experienced Project Managers, Superintendents, Field Leads, and Leadership while learning BF Construction’s systems, processes, and standards.

**Job Description**
-------------------


When the work you do every single day has a crucial impact on the lives of others, every effort, every detail, and every second matters. This shared culture of passion and dedication pulses through Cedars\-Sinai, and it’s just one of the many reasons it was recognized by **U.S. News \& World Report’s ‘Best Hospitals’ Honor Roll for the eleventh consecutive year and tied \#1 in California \& Los Angeles**. Our 915\-bed nonprofit, acute, tertiary, teaching Level I trauma center hospital is in the heart of Los Angeles. The Pharmacy Department has over 500 team members who are dedicated on providing both inpatient and outpatient pharmacy services, ensuring that patients receive high\-quality care tailored to their needs.


Join Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center at the forefront of one of the most transformative areas of medicine. In this highly collaborative role, you will help design the infrastructure, governance, workflows, and partnerships needed to safely and effectively evaluate, procure, coordinate, administer, and monitor commercially approved, investigational, and emerging CGT products. Working closely with physicians, pharmacists, laboratory and research teams, finance leaders, and other key stakeholders, you will help translate innovative therapies into accessible, efficient, and patient\-centered care. As the CGT field continues to evolve, you will identify emerging opportunities, support strategic planning, and help shape the future of therapy delivery at Cedars\-Sinai. Your leadership will contribute to the safe, equitable, and financially responsible growth of CGT services while advancing the organization’s clinical, academic, and research missions.


This position has a flexible hybrid opportunity (up to 50% remote) and inpatient staffing (1 weekend per month) requirement.

* Possesses experience in drug information services and formulary development
* Exhibits excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrates ability to prioritize projects to meet goals

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About AADAP, Inc.**

The Asian American Drug Abuse Program (AADAP) is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to serving Asian Pacific Islanders and other underserved communities with substance abuse services throughout Los Angeles County. Programs and services are provided to all individuals regardless of race or ethnicity.

**Department Overview**

Youth \& Family Programs (YFP) provides AADAP’s Gang Reduction and Youth Development (GRYD) Prevention services. The program works with youth, families, community partners, and public agencies to support prevention, family case management, youth development, and community education activities.

**Position Summary**

The GRYD Program Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day operations and coordination of AADAP’s GRYD Prevention program. This position provides direct supervision and support to program staff, coordinates service delivery, monitors program performance and documentation, and helps ensure contractual and program requirements are met.

The Program Coordinator also serves as a liaison with the GRYD Office, LAPD, intervention partners, community organizations, and other stakeholders. The ideal candidate is an organized and collaborative supervisor who can support staff, manage competing priorities, and build strong relationships with youth, families, and community partners.

**Essential Job Functions \& Responsibilities**

**Program Coordination \& Service Delivery**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day GRYD program activities and ensure services align with program goals and objectives.
* Monitor program activities and action steps to support timely and effective implementation.
* Guide staff through GRYD implementation and program services.
* Coordinate and support GRYD Prevention and Family Case Management services.
* Support youth development activities, community education campaigns, and other program activities.
* Monitor the quality and quantity of services and take appropriate action to help ensure contract requirements and program goals are met.
* Participate in meetings and trainings relevant to the program’s target population and geographic area.

**Staff Supervision \& Development**

* Supervise Primary and Secondary level program staff, including regular check\-ins, performance monitoring, coaching, and support.
* Assess staff training and development needs and coordinate required GRYD and agency training.
* Conduct annual performance evaluations consistent with agency policy.
* Provide training, technical assistance, and consultation to GRYD and support staff.
* Support the recruitment and hiring of line staff, including candidate screening, interviewing, and hiring recommendations.

**Program Administration \& Compliance**

* Monitor and review GRYD case files and ETO data entry for completeness and accuracy.
* Prepare and submit required reports and billing documentation.
* Monitor GRYD case management performance and other program benchmarks.
* Monitor program expenditures in coordination with program leadership.
* Assist the Director with contract\-related activities, proposal writing, and fund\-seeking efforts.
* Perform duties of the Unit Director in their absence, as assigned.

**Community \& Partner Engagement**

* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with the GRYD Office, LAPD, intervention partners, schools, community organizations, and other stakeholders.
* Serve as a liaison between AADAP services, GRYD programs, and outside services and programs.
* Represent AADAP and the program at community meetings, events, and partner activities.
* Support community outreach, youth development activities, and community education efforts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Six (6\) years of college education in a related field or equivalent work experience related to the field.
* At least two (2\) years of supervision experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Bilingual or bicultural proficiency in Arabic, Armenian, Cantonese, Farsi, Urdu, Khmer (Cambodian), Korean, Mandarin, Russian, Spanish, Tagalog, Vietnamese, or another language reflective of the communities served.
* Familiarity with the program target area and surrounding community.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

* Demonstrated knowledge and skills in computer operations.
* Strong leadership and staff supervision skills.
* Strong organizational, planning, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, documentation requirements, and deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers, youth, families, community organizations, partner agencies, and the general public.
* Ability to provide constructive feedback, coaching, and support to staff.
* Ability to work effectively and respectfully with people of diverse cultural, educational, social, and economic backgrounds.
* Professional, dependable, collaborative, and tactful approach to working with others.
* Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse cultural, educational, social, and economic backgrounds.

**Special Requirements**

* Employment contingent upon successful background check clearance.
* Proof of work eligibility required upon hire.
* Valid California Driver’s License, minimum automobile insurance, and access to a reliable motor vehicle.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including some evenings and weekends.

**Work Schedule, Travel \& Physical Demands**

* **Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week; requires flexibility for some evening and weekend program activities.
* **Travel:** Local travel is required for program activities, meetings, community events, and partner engagement.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**

We’re a fast\-paced, growing fire sprinkler company that keeps buildings safe and compliant. Our team is hardworking, supportive, and driven to get the job done right the first time. We’re seeking a detail\-oriented and organized Operations Coordinator to help keep our company running smoothly. If you’re skilled with Excel, enjoy keeping things organized, have strong verbal and written communication skills, and have a team\-first attitude, we’d love to meet you.

**What You’ll Do**

In this role, you’ll play a key part in supporting our technicians, customers, and management. Typical responsibilities include:

· Schedule foremen and field personnel across multiple active projects based on manpower needs and project timelines

· Develop and maintain accurate manpower load charts to support workforce planning and forecasting

· Order and coordinate delivery of materials to ensure timely jobsite availability

· Order, schedule, and track rental equipment and specialty tools

· Assist in preparation for and participation in project coordination meetings

· Communicate regularly with Project Managers, Engineering, Superintendent, and field staff to support operational efficiency

· Track and adjust schedules as project needs evolve

· Support documentation and reporting related to manpower, equipment, and material allocation

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2\+ years of administrative or office experience (construction or fire protection is a plus).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, sorting/filtering, basic functions) and Outlook (email/calendar).
* Excellent communication skills — both written and verbal.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A team player with a positive attitude who is also comfortable working independently.

**Bonus Points For:**

* Experience working with fire sprinkler, fire protection, or construction service companies.
* Familiarity with billing and invoicing processes.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay (DOE)
* Health, dental, vision, life insurance and retirement benefits
* Paid time off and holidays.
* A supportive, team\-first work environment.
* Opportunities to learn and grow in the fire protection industry.

**Schedule**

* Full\-time: Monday–Friday, 7:00 am \-4:00 pm
* Occasional overtime may be required during urgent projects.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SOCIAL MEDIA + PR ACCOUNT COORDINATOR / JR. ACCOUNT MANAGER / ACCOUNT MANAGER
jobs.description:
RAGDOLL PR is looking for a creative, highly organized \+ social media\-savvy **Account Coordinator or Jr. Account Manager** (maybe even Account Manager) to join our growing team and work across our fashion, beauty, wellness, health \+ lifestyle clients.

This role is ideal for someone who **lives and breathes social media**, has a strong eye for content \+ branding, understands what performs across IG and TikTok, and also has experience within PR, influencer relations and/or brand communications.

**Executive Administrative Assistant \& Sales Coordinator**

**L. Johnson Construction, Inc. – Gardena, CA**  
**Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| $30\.00 per hour**

**About the Role**

L. Johnson Construction is a small, family\-owned construction company seeking an experienced Executive Administrative Assistant to provide direct, hands\-on support to the Owner.

This is not an entry\-level administrative position. The successful candidate must have prior experience directly supporting an executive, business owner, or senior leader and be comfortable managing a fast\-moving schedule, changing priorities, detailed follow\-up, and a high volume of day\-to\-day communication.

The role is primarily executive and administrative support, with an additional sales coordination component involving lead research and follow\-up.

The Owner is involved in L. Johnson Construction as well as three additional family\-owned business entities. This position will provide administrative support across those business interests and will also assist with occasional personal business during normal working hours.

There is no expectation of after\-hours availability.

**The Right Person for This Role**

* Naturally keeps executives organized and one step ahead.

* Adapts to different leadership styles and learns how your executive prefers to work.
* Can manage interruptions without becoming flustered.
* Is persistent about following up and closing open items.
* Communicates professionally and discreetly.

**Executive \& Administrative Support 85%**

* Provide direct daily administrative support to the Owner.

* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and track business and personal appointments.

* Prepare documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, correspondence, and other administrative materials.
* Handle incoming calls, mail, electronic communications, and general office administration.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical files.

* Handle occasional personal administrative matters for the Owner during normal working hours.

**Sales \& Lead Coordination 15%**

* Professional telephone and email communication skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and use discretion with sensitive information.
* Comfortable receiving direct feedback and adapting to an executive's individual work and communication preferences.

jobs.description:
About Hollywood Park  

  

Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300\-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke, it stands as the largest urban mixed\-use development currently under construction in the Western United States. The vibrant "city within a city" features sophisticated residences, a dynamic outdoor retail and lifestyle district, creative office spaces, public parks, and a scenic lake. Anchored by the world\-class SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater, with Hollywood Park Studios and a luxury boutique hotel forthcoming, the district creates the ultimate Live, Work, Play environment.
  

Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3\.1 million\-square\-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor\-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. A proven global leader that consistently ranks among the world’s top venues in ticket sales, the stadium has already hosted iconic events like eight FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, Super Bowl LVI, the 2023 College Football National Championship, WrestleMania 39, the CONCACAF Gold Cup Final, and numerous record\-breaking concerts. SoFi Stadium is set to host the Super Bowl LXI in 2027, the Olympic and Paralympic Opening Ceremonies for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (LA28\), along with being converted into the largest Olympic swimming venue in history.
Adjacent to the stadium and under the same sweeping translucent roof canopy sits the 2\.5\-acre open\-air American Airlines Plaza and the 6,000\-seat YouTube Theater. As an intimate, state\-of\-the\-art venue, YouTube Theater hosts a diverse line\-up of chart\-topping superstars, iconic comedy acts, awards shows, esports competitions, community gatherings, and corporate conferences. Named the “Top West Coast Club or Theater” by Billboard, YouTube Theater is a must\-play destination.
  

Culture
  

Hollywood Park is being brought to life by a deeply experienced team of creative forward\-thinkers. The project is a celebration of all that Los Angeles has to offer. We are inspired by our diverse Inglewood community as a place for the community to be, to see and to connect.
Hollywood Park is committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our team members, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.  

  

At the heart of Hollywood Park, lies our dedication to our purpose, promise, and commitments. Our **PURPOSE** is creating extraordinary experiences, one moment at a time. Our **PROMISE** is to be an iconic destination that celebrates our diverse and vibrant community. We promise to exceed expectations while cultivating a fun and safe experience where lasting memories are made. Our **COMMITMENTS** are outlined by **S.T.A.R.S.**  

  

Our **S.T.A.R.S.** commitments are enabled by five foundational principles:
* **Start with Care** – create a lasting impact through genuine care
* **Thrive as a Team** – create an environment of collaboration and encouragement
* **Anticipate Unspoken Needs** – be proactive in delivering extraordinary service and support others
* **Resolve with Respect** – treat others with empathy, patience, and kindness
* **Safety Always** – maintain a safe and secure environment

The Operations Coordinator position will aid in the oversight of all conversions and other event operational tasks within SoFi Stadium as well as support and execute any daily operational needs of the building and campus. The SoFi Stadium and Hollywood Park Operations Coordinator will execute and lead others in the daily and continual preparation and upkeep of the venue and campus.

**Position**: Production Coordinator  

**Location**: Santa Monica, CA (Onsite)  

**Requisition Number:** 1038  

* **Pay Range**: $24\.00 \- $26\.00 USD hourly

  

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  

The Episodic Production Coordinator functions as an extension of a lead producer and be a main point of contact while working with internal and external teams to organize, supervise, and monitor the progress of projects. Possessing a sense of urgency, the Episodic Production Coordinator demonstrates an ability to work within a fast\-paced and collaborative environment, delivering accurate and quality work on schedule, and has excellent skills in building relationships and communicating effectively. In an operations capacity, this role requires a highly professional demeanor and diplomacy when dealing with clients, production management, coworkers, and artists. The Production Coordinator reports into the Head of Production and actively provides support and executes task\-based work for the episodic finishing producing team.
Location: This position will require working in our Santa Monica studio on a regular basis. You may also be required to travel and work out of our studio in Hollywood, as needed.


Hours: 3 PM \- 11:35 PM Monday \- Friday. Available to work overtime and variable shifts, including late nights, weekends and holidays, as necessary per business needs.

 **MAIN DUTIES:**  

The Production Coordinator will help the Lead Producer manage and drive online, color and delivery schedules. They will act as a main point of contact alongside your producer for their internal CO3 team and clients via in\-person interactions, e\-mail, and phone. They will also assist in maintaining effective communication with the internal team and clients regarding job status. They will help coordinate and verify project needs prior to any session start times and/or client arrivals as well as deliveries. They will help keep a pulse on all projects being produced including the status of individual show/episodes and budgets.
The following tasks illustrate some of the primary responsibilities:

* Firsthand communication with Producers upon arrival and throughout the day.
* Assist in the collection and logging of project statuses and key information.
* Keep the production team up to date on project status.
* Generate prep and post status reports, daily memos, and week at glances.
* Support episodic assists with project information, prioritizing tasks, and ensuring they have the elements to complete their tasks.
* Interface with client if required elements for jobs are missing.
* Assist producer in the creation, actualizing and billing of work orders.
* Ensure all resources assigned to job are available as scheduled.
* Make sure projects and resources are ready for sessions to begin on time.
* Work with Producer and assistants to troubleshoot any session related problems.
* Assist in greeting and escorting clients to the bays upon arrival.
* Assist in checking in on artists, clients, assists, and client services on a regular basis to make sure the session is well supported.
* Notify the Producer if any delivery deadlines that will or are in jeopardy of being missed.
* Setting up test feeds prior to session, including all face\-to\-face virtual interaction.
* Communicating with our Engineers if any network issues arise.
* Engage Engineering staff to resolve urgent technical problems.
* Project scheduling.
* Coordinating project details across sister facilities.

**WHAT YOU BRING:**  

The ideal candidate will bring a self\-starting and a positive, can\-do attitude. They will be adaptable, organized, and proactive. They will work great in collaboration with all members of a project. They will be perseverant under pressure in a quick pace environment. The ideal candidate will also bring the following:* Previous experience in Entertainment/Film/Arts.
* Episodic or Feature Finishing Post\-Production Experience.
* Basic knowledge of offline editing, VFX and sound workflows.
* Basic knowledge of scheduling the post process.
* Media Pulse and/or post\-production scheduling software experience.
* Background and/or knowledge of offline editing.
* Basic knowledge of task based software (ClickUp, Asana, Jira).

Company 3, including its various business units and family of brands, provides a full range of Creative Services for content creators, including conceptual design, pre\-vis, look development, ideation and rapid prototyping, 3D animation/CGI, motion graphics/designers, matte painting, compositing, dailies and production services, color grading, post\-production finishing, marketing/trailers, live\-action production, experiences, and more.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Ziering Medical is a world\-class hair restoration practice with locations in Beverly Hills, New York City, Greenwich, CT, and West Palm Beach, FL. At the helm of our practice is Founder and Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Craig L. Ziering, who leads the company with a passion for his patients and the hair restoration industry. Empathy for every patient’s hair loss story and excitement for their life\-changing hair restoration journey is the hallmark of every Ziering employee. Ziering Medical offers advanced surgical and non\-surgical hair restoration treatments, techniques, and therapeutics.

**Job Summary**

Ziering Medical is seeking a highly motivated, detail\-orientated Digital Content Coordinator to enhance our digital presence and strengthen our position as a premium, physician\-led hair restoration brand. This is a hands\-on content creation and performance role. This role will own day\-to\-day content creation and the social/content calendar in partnership with the Marketing team, with a particular focus on patient transformation stories, before\-and\-after content, physician education, brand storytelling, and performance\-driven social campaigns. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a medical/aesthetic environment, interacting professionally with patients and physicians, and translating clinical expertise into compelling, accessible content.

**Responsibilities**

* Create platform\-native content, including short\-form video, Reels, Stories, carousels, static posts, educational videos, interviews, behind\-the\-scenes content, and paid creative.
* Move quickly from content opportunity to finished asset while maintaining a consistently high production and creative standard.
* Write compelling captions, headlines, hooks, scripts, and supporting copy that are accurate, engaging, brand\-appropriate, and optimized for the intended audience.
* Identify emerging formats, trends, sounds, platform features, and storytelling opportunities appropriate for a premium medical brand.

* Maintain an organized, searchable content library of patient photography, video, testimonials, physician content, and other approved assets.
* Ensure appropriate patient consents and releases are obtained, documented, and respected before content is used in social media, advertising, marketing, or other channels.

* Develop and execute paid social creative and campaigns, including static and video ads, in partnership with the Marketing team.
* Suggest and test new content concepts and audience approaches designed to attract, engage, and convert prospective patients.

**Performance, Analytics \& Accountability**

* Track content and social performance against defined KPIs, including engagement rate, reach, impressions, follower growth, website traffic, lead generation, lead\-to\-consult conversion where trackable, and paid campaign performance.
* Regularly report performance to the SVP of Marketing, identify trends and opportunities, and make data\-informed recommendations for improving content and campaign results.
* Test creative, messaging, formats, hooks, calls to action, and publishing approaches; use performance data to determine what should be scaled, refined, or discontinued.
* Connect social and content performance to broader marketing and business objectives rather than evaluating success solely on likes or follower counts.

**Brand Standards \& Reputation**

* Maintain Ziering Medical’s luxury, premium, physician\-led positioning across every piece of content and digital interaction.
* Ensure visual identity, tone, voice, messaging, medical accuracy, and overall presentation consistently reflect Ziering Medical brand standards and reputation.
* Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, and relevant social conversations; respond appropriately within established guidelines and promptly escalate patient\-specific questions, complaints, clinical concerns, or sensitive issues.
* Protect patient privacy and maintain professionalism and discretion when working with patients, physicians, employees, influencers, vendors, and the public.

**AI, Technology \& Digital Innovation**

* Use current AI\-enabled content creation when appropriate, editing, transcription, ideation, analytics, and workflow tools to improve speed, quality, efficiency, and creative output.
* Identify practical opportunities to integrate emerging technologies into the marketing workflow while maintaining brand quality, hum

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**



Founded in 2004, Applied Biological Materials (abm) Inc. is a global leader in cell biology and cell engineering, leveraging advanced technologies and model systems including CRISPR gene editing, iPSC technologies, and advanced cell models to support groundbreaking discoveries in Life Sciences and Drug Development. Our headquarters in Vancouver, Canada, spans over 30,000 sq. ft. of state\-of\-the\-art wet lab and office space, serving as a hub for advanced R\&D and global logistics. Based in Canada, abm operates internationally with locations in the United States, China, and France, serving academic, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, government, and research customers worldwide.

 **About the Role**



As part of our continued expansion in the United States, abm is looking for a **Sales Account Manager** to manage and grow our **U.S. West Territory**, with a West Coast base location preferred. This role is responsible for managing and expanding existing customer accounts and developing new relationships across academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions.



You will act as a key point of contact for customers in the region, identifying needs, proposing tailored solutions, and driving business growth. The ideal candidate will bring both sales expertise and a strong understanding of the life sciences sector, with a proactive, customer\-first mindset. Experience selling **cell lines, cell\-based products, or related life science research products** is strongly preferred.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


* Manage and expand customer accounts across the U.S. West Territory, including key life science hubs and academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions
* Identify new business opportunities and drive revenue growth
* Build long\-term relationships with researchers, laboratory leaders, procurement contacts, and other key decision\-makers and influencers.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, both virtually and in person, to understand research needs and identify opportunities for abm products and services.
* Develop territory and account plans, prioritize high\-potential customers, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Identify customer needs and work with internal technical and product teams to recommend appropriate solutions.
* Meet or exceed assigned revenue targets, sales KPIs, and territory growth objectives.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and activity information in the CRM system.
* Collaborate closely with Technical Support, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and other internal teams to provide a strong customer experience.
* Represent abm at regional conferences, trade shows, scientific meetings, and other customer\-facing events.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity and provide feedback to support commercial strategy.
* Travel regularly within the assigned territory for customer meetings, conferences, and events, with occasional travel to other abm locations as required.

  


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an asset.
* Minimum **2 years of experience in business development, account management, or technical sales within the life sciences or biotechnology sector**.

**Regional Revenue Operations Manager** 

Long Beach, CA – Onsite

Sierra Pacific Engineering and Products (SPEP) designs, manufactures, and proudly distributes high quality, cost\-effective industrial hardware components B2B. As an ISO\-certified industrial hardware company, our vision is to bring growth and stability to our customers through sustainable methods of engineering, service, and value.

**Employee\-Powered, Employee\-Owned \-** Our employees make SPEP all that it is. This belief is reinforced with the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) providing employees with 100% ownership in the business and the opportunity to benefit from the company’s success.

**Position Summary**

The Regional Revenue Operations Manager is a full\-time position responsible for supporting the company’s effectiveness by developing, analyzing, and governing regional revenue strategies, pricing standards, account segmentation, and market approaches. This role partners with internal departments to shape policies, tools, and initiatives that drive sustainable revenue growth.

The role exercises independent judgment in evaluating customer requirements, structuring proposals/quotes, and aligning internal resources to manage and/or support business goals.

The Regional Revenue Operations Manager serves as a critical link between Outside Sales Representatives, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations ensuring timely and accurate communication and project management.

**Responsibilities**

**Sales Strategy \& Governance**

* Develops and maintains regional sales strategies, account segmentation frameworks, and go\-to\-market models.
* Recommends and enforces pricing standards, discount thresholds, and deal\-review standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales leadership.
* Evaluates sales enablement tools and recommends structural improvements.
* Evaluates and prioritizes inbound leads based on strategic criteria and business impact. Conducts discovery with prospects to assess fit and recommend solutions.
* Completes timely communication to ensure new lead engagement and dormant lead re\-engagement with the associated Outside Sales Representatives.

**Business Operations \& Analysis**

* Analyzes market trends, customer trends, and competitive positioning to inform decision\-making.
* Prepares reports, forecasts, and recommendations regarding sales performance and risk.
* Assesses the financial and operational impact of proposed initiatives.

**Policy, Process \& Enablement**

* Collaborates with the Outside Sales team to create and execute account strategies. Provides consultative input on technical solutions, market positioning, and customer engagement approaches to accelerate growth in key accounts.
* Analyzes customer data, market trends and competitor activity to provide insights for leadership.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Leads cross\-functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, Engineering, and Supply Chain.
* Initiates independent recommendations on prioritization of markets, products, and customer segments in partnership with sales leadership.
* Escalates and resolves complex business issues with material, financial or operational impact.
* Maintains strong transitions with all internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction through timely updates and proactive communication.
* Serves as internal advisor providing cross\-functional recommendations for revenue initiatives.

**Quote Management**

* Governs quoting and pricing standards.
* Reviews non\-standard pricing requests and makes recommendations.
* Evaluates RFQs for strategic alignment, revenue impact, and operational feasibility prior to approval.
* Partners with Outside Sales to ensure deals comply with established policies.
* Oversees the RFQ process for custom parts coordinating with Engineering and Supply Chain departments. Exercises judgment in balancing customer requirements, feasibility, and profitability before presenting recommendations for approval.
* Provides regular communication regarding status updates and action items.

jobs.description:
**\*\* This role sits in Glendale, CA and the person is required to be in the office, 4 days/ week. \*\***

**About the Role \& Team**


The Executive Assistant will provide primary administrative support to the **Senior Vice President, Management Audit and Global Product \& Labor Standards at The Walt Disney Company, while also providing additional administrative support to an additional Vice President**.


This role offers broad exposure to the enterprise through its partnership with the following corporate teams:

* **The Corporate Management Audit team** is responsible for developing and executing a worldwide, risk\-based internal audit plan for the Company, as well as monitoring and assessing the risks associated with the Company’s internal control environment, including as it relates to the Company’s strategic objectives and growth plans.
* **The Global Product \& Labor Standards team** is responsible for managing the global, enterprise\-wide Company supply chain compliance programs in support of the Company’s commitment to ethical and responsible sourcing: the Product Integrity Program and the International Labor Standards Program.


The team is global in scope, consisting of teams that span across North America, Latin America, EMEA, and APAC. Given the international footprint, the Executive Assistant must be comfortable supporting stakeholders across multiple time zones and navigating a fast\-paced, highly matrixed environment.

**What You Will Do**


This role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure across the enterprise while partnering closely with senior executives and teams across the Company. The Executive Assistant will serve as a trusted strategic partner to the SVP, helping maximize executive effectiveness through proactive calendar management, confidential communications support, travel coordination, meeting and event logistics, and operational support.

**In this role you will:**

* Provide primary administrative support to the Senior Vice President, Management Audit and Global Product \& Labor Standards, while providing support to an additional Vice President.
* Manage complex executive calendars, prioritize competing demands, coordinate meetings across a global organization, and proactively protect executive time.
* Serve as a trusted partner to the executive by anticipating needs, exercising sound judgment, and helping drive overall effectiveness and efficiency.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements and assist with expense reporting and related documentation.
* Handle highly confidential communications, reports, and sensitive business information with the utmost discretion and accuracy.
* Plan and execute meeting logistics, including conference room reservations, catering, presentation materials, and technology support.
* Support team operations, including facilities coordination, invoice processing, and other administrative activities that contribute to a productive workplace.
* Coordinate logistics for team events, training programs, leadership meetings, town halls, and special projects.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the company to facilitate collaboration, problem\-solving, and effective executive support.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and leverage technology, including AI\-enabled tools, to enhance efficiency and team effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* At least five (5\) years of Executive Assistant experience supporting senior executives in a large, fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Demonstrated expertise managing highly complex executive calendars with significant scheduling volume and competing priorities.
* Experience supporting senior\-level leaders and interacting regularly with executive offices.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Proven ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Self\-starter who can work independently with minimal direction.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and resourcefulness.
* Proven ability to build effective working relationships across a large organization.
* Experience coordinating domestic and international travel arrangements and expense reporting.
* Experience supporting meetings, events, and executive presentations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Comfort supporting a global organization and working across multiple time zones.
* Strong customer\-service mindset and commitment to executive excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven knowledge of enterprise Disney processes, structure, and practices
* Working knowledge of programs such as SAP, COUPA, Airtable, Concur, Loop, and AI platforms
* Administrative experience in a corporate environment with proven success interacting, partnering, and networking with all levels of management, including executives (directors and vice presidents) in a fast\-paced dynamic environment

**Education**

* High School Diploma or equivalent work experience

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid role, onsite in our Encino office 4 days/week. You must currently live in the Greater Los Angeles area — we're not able to consider remote candidates or candidates requiring relocation for this position.


About the Role

***Kurv*** is a trusted payment processor headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, with locations across the country. As a leading provider, Kurv offers merchant services, credit card processing, mobile and contactless payment solutions (including Tap\-to\-Pay and QR payments), and eCommerce payment gateways for SMBs, delivering robust solutions that simplify and expedite how businesses accept payments.


We're looking for a Social Media Manager to own the day\-to\-day content, community, and performance of our social channels across two distinct B2B brands. You'll plan and execute a consistent content calendar across Reddit, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and X, partner with our in\-house team of designers, video editors, PR, and event specialists to bring posts to life, and use data to continuously sharpen what we publish and when. This role sits at the intersection of creative and performance, working closely with paid media, SEO, and communications functions.

**Content Creation**

* Plan 30\-day content calendars across Reddit, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and X
* Write captions and create or coordinate with designers to finalize posts
* Apply conversion\-focused CTAs and UTMs for tracking
* Test UTMs and forms to ensure accurate CRM lead capture; coordinate with dev on fixes
* Partner with internal and external teams to create and amplify assets and campaigns
* Pitch short\-form content ideas, angles, and clip selections to the video editor for repurposing long\-form video
* Maintain consistent brand identity while adapting tone, format, and strategy to each brand's positioning

**Analytics \& Reporting**

* Track KPIs (impressions, engagement, CTR) to continuously improve campaigns
* Test copy and visuals on key posts to identify top\-performing strategies
* Share high\-performing organic content with the paid media team for boosting and advertisement adaptation
* Liaise with the paid media team on advertising and influencer campaigns
* Time publishing to peak engagement windows by platform and audience
* Monitor trends, competitor performance, and algorithm updates to inform strategy
* Use SEO and GSC insights to inform content strategy
* Liaise with the sales teams and key stakeholders to stay advised on down\-funnel campaign impacts
* Deliver monthly performance recaps with wins, learnings, and recommendations
* Community Engagement
* Monitor DMs and comments; partner with the Communications Manager on responses, when applicable
* Liaise with the communications team to amplify PR, thought leadership, and customer loyalty content
* Engage in relevant Facebook groups to build community
* Identify and cultivate relationships with creators, partners, and brand advocates for organic amplification

**Who Thrives in This Role**

* This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility seat. You'll be in constant communication with the Director of Brand and Creative and the CMO circulating insights and strategy, not just checking in on a schedule. You'll do well here if you:
* Communicate early and often, flagging both successes and opportunities
* Bring real energy to the work. Ask questions, offer up data\-backed suggestions, push back when something doesn't add up, and strive to understand the "why"
* Take ownership of your piece in the brands’ owned media landscape and jump at opportunities to collaborate with other marketing channel owners

**Qualifications**

* 4\-6 years of experience managing social media for a brand, agency, or in\-house marketing team
* Proven track record of growing engagement and lead generation through organic social
* Strong writing skills with the ability to adapt tone across multiple brand voices
* Comfortable working with data; pulling reports, spotting trends, and translating numbers into action
* Experience coordinating with designers, video editors, or external creative partners
* Familiarity with UTM tracking, CRM lead flow, or performance marketing fundamentals is a plus
* B2B, fintech, or payments industry experience is a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field, or equivalent experience
* Tools \& Software
* Sprout Social
* Google Analytics/GA4, Google Search Console, native platform insights
* Zoho CRM
* Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite

**Join the Team at Millennium Hotels \& Resorts**
At **Millennium Hotels \& Resorts**, we are driven by a commitment to excellence, innovation, and delivering exceptional hospitality experiences across a global portfolio. Our corporate teams play a critical role in supporting our properties, driving strategy, and enabling operational success.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.

jobs.title: CL Renewal Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**


As a Renewal Marketing Specialist, you will manage the end\-to\-end marketing process for commercial lines renewals. Your responsibilities will include examining coverage needs, negotiating carrier terms, preparing proposals, binding coverage, and ensuring a smooth transition of accounts to the local client service team.

**What You'll Do:**

* Collaborate closely with sales associates and client service teams to develop effective renewal marketing strategies.
* Review and validate submissions for completeness and adherence to best practices, then send to carriers and obtain quotes.
* Respond to underwriters’ inquiries and negotiate coverage terms with carriers on behalf of clients.
* Review carrier quotations and prepare detailed comparison summaries.
* Finalize marketing efforts and create client\-ready proposal presentations.
* Bind coverage and execute a seamless hand\-off to the appropriate client service team.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with carrier underwriters and representatives.
* Serve as a technical resource on market trends, pricing practices, and underwriting policies.
* Maintain a high degree of accuracy in agency management systems and technology platforms.
* Stay current on industry developments, new products, legislation, coverages, and technology.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 5\+ years of experience in commercial property \& casualty insurance.
* College degree preferred; Property \& Casualty insurance license required.
* Comprehensive understanding of property \& casualty coverages, underwriting, and rating concepts.
* Vertical expertise preferred (e.g., construction, manufacturing, real estate, healthcare, financial services).
* Industry designations such as ARM, CIC, CPCU are a plus.
* Exceptional critical thinking, negotiation, and organizational skills with the ability to manage complex tasks.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; knowledge of Sagitta/ImageRight is preferred.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment with minimal supervision.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with strong relationship management abilities.


**Why USI?**  

With approximately $3 billion in revenue and over 10,500 associates across approximately 200 offices nationwide, USI is one of the largest insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the world. At USI, we have created one of the most dynamic personal and professional development cultures in the industry. We invest heavily in our associates, and we take pride in celebrating their growth and success through our one\-of\-a\-kind employee reward and recognition programs.

**Unrivaled Resources and Support**  

What truly distinguishes USI as a premier insurance brokerage and consulting firm is the **USI ONE Advantage®**, a game\-changing value proposition that delivers to clients a robust set of risk management and benefit solutions with bottom\-line financial impact. USI ONE® represents Omni, Network, Enterprise—the three key elements that set USI apart from the competition. Through USI ONE, we develop strategic, timely, and effective risk management and benefit programs in terms that are easy to understand, and we demonstrate how the solutions can have a positive economic impact.

**Industry\-Leading Programs, Rewards, and Recognition**  

In addition to competitive pay, incentives, and benefits, USI recognizes associates through our Summit Awards program, rewarding excellence in those who build our brand each day. USI offers **employee programs** that recognize outstanding achievement and help our associates lead healthy, productive lives. We turn care into action with our award\-winning wellness program, college scholarships for associates' children, and financial help in times of need.

**Deep Community Engagement**  

We are committed to giving back to our local communities and supporting a culture of environmental sustainability. From sharing our time, talent, and resources to support local non\-profit organizations, animal shelters, and environmental beautification and restoration projects – to partnering with eco\-conscious vendors and taking steps to reduce our own environmental footprint – we’re working **together as ONE** to build a better future.

**Committed to a Diverse and Inclusive Workplace**  

Our award\-winning **I’m With U** diversity and inclusion program educates our associates to help them better understand and serve our clients, prospects, fellow team members, and local communities through curated education and training resources, employee support programs, and community outreach initiatives to build a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture.

 **Nationally Recognized as a Top Insurance Employer**

* Recognized as one of Insurance Business America’s Top Insurance Employers eight consecutive years (2018\-2025\).
* Named to Business Insurance’s annual list of the Best Places to Work in Insurance six years in a row (2020\-2025\).
* Named to Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services \& Insurance list for the last two years (2024\-2025\).
* Certified as a Great Place To Work two years in a row (2024\-2025\).


Visit our **Awards and Accolades page** for a complete list of our latest industry awards and recognitions!


*USI is committed to providing a full\-suite of competitive benefits for our growing population and its diverse needs. We offer a wide range of health, welfare and financial benefits including medical, wellness, dental and vision, 401(k), flexible spending and health savings accounts, short and long\-term disability, life insurance and other unique employer\-sponsored and voluntary programs. USI also offers a generous paid time off policy, paid family leave benefit as well as paid holiday time**.*

jobs.description:
**Air / Ocean Operations Coordinator**

**Location:** Los Angeles / Chicago**Employment Type:** Full\-Time**Department:** Operations

**Position Overview**

This role is designed for candidates who want to gain **hands\-on, end\-to\-end experience in international logistics**, rather than performing repetitive or limited system\-based tasks.

As an **Air / Ocean Operations Coordinator**, you will be directly involved in the full shipment life cycle — from booking and transportation to arrival, customs coordination, and final delivery. This position provides a strong foundation for long\-term growth in logistics operations, cost control, and cross\-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Customer \& Shipment Execution**

Communicate with customers to receive and confirm shipment requirements for air and ocean freight

Assist in developing practical and executable transportation plans based on customer needs and operational constraints

Monitor shipments from origin to final delivery, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clear communication

**2\. Air \& Ocean Freight Operations**

Coordinate bookings, flight schedules, vessel schedules, and space confirmations

Liaise with airlines, shipping lines, and overseas agents to ensure smooth execution of transportation plans

Track shipment status and provide timely updates through internal systems and direct customer communication

**3\. Arrival, Customs \& Delivery Coordination**

Work closely with customs, warehouse, and trucking teams to coordinate post\-arrival operations

Ensure smooth handoff between customs clearance, cargo release, and final delivery

Support the handling of inspections, documentation requests, delays, and other operational issues

**4\. Exception \& Issue Management**

Identify and follow up on operational exceptions such as delays, documentation discrepancies, or execution errors

Assist in analyzing root causes and coordinating solutions with internal and external partners

Gradually build the ability to handle more complex cases independently as experience grows

**5\. Cost \& Billing Support**

Assist with reviewing AR/AP charges related to shipments

Ensure billing accuracy and alignment with operational records

Develop an understanding of logistics cost structures to support future career advancement

**Qualifications**

Strong interest in international logistics, supply chain, or freight forwarding

Detail\-oriented, responsible, and capable of managing multiple shipments simultaneously

Effective communication skills and ability to coordinate across teams and external partners

Prior experience in air/ocean freight or logistics is a plus; motivated entry\-level candidates are welcome

**Hourly Rate:** USD 21–27, based on experience and qualifications

Year\-end performance bonus

jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News \& World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second\-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  

  

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.
The UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR) is driven to improve health and wellness of people in Orange County and the world by providing life\-saving clinical trials designed to strengthen and accelerate the pathway of discovery from the medical laboratory to the clinic.  


Responsibilities:

Independently or under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, and the Assistant Director of Clinical Research Operations, the incumbent leads the day\-to\-day execution of assigned clinical trials in the UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR). Serving as primary coordinator on trials of varying complexity, the incumbent is accountable for accurate execution, documentation, and communication for comprehensive coordination and data management of complex phase I – IV clinical research protocols from initiation through close\-out of research projects with human subjects. The incumbent operates in an interdisciplinary model across multiple therapeutic areas. This position facilitates all implementation phases of new clinical research studies as well as the ongoing coordination and maintenance of open and closed studies. Incumbent will conduct interviews with study patients in the clinic, screen participants, facilitate patient care, and collect data in compliance with established study protocols. The incumbent will receive appropriate onboarding and training to ensure proper preparation for this role as well as ongoing training where appropriate.
  

  

Develop and establish process for review and oversight of clinical trials conducted by investigators and ensure study protocols are followed, appropriate documentation is kept, and accurate data is collected according to Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/ International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, internal standard operating procedures (SOPs), FDA regulations, and University policies and procedures. This position plays a key role in assisting the Principal Investigator (PI) in recruiting patients for clinical studies and meeting enrollment and retention goals.
  

  

Complete timely and accurate collection and coordination of data submission to study sponsors ensuring quality control and leading to timely milestone payments. This includes responsibility for the compilation and transcription of research patient data and study\-related information into case report forms (CRFs) into sponsor specific electronic data capture systems (EDC). S/he will work with the clinical research team to manage and collect accurate data and assist Principal Investigators and study coordinators for all data management aspects of non\-cancer related trials.
  

  

The incumbent is also responsible for maintaining communication with all elements of a multi\-level research network, interacting with sponsoring agencies and compliance and regulatory groups such as the Institutional Review Board (IRB), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and sponsor monitors. This individual will interact with subjects, clinic and research staff, laboratory staff, radiology staff and any other medical professionals associated with our clinical research protocols. In addition, this individual must maintain clinical trial information in the clinical trial management system (OnCore) and adhere to institutional policies.
  

  

The main CCR offices and clinics are located at the UCI Medical Center in Orange and the UCI campus in Irvine, as well as various clinics at community sites throughout Orange County. The incumbent will be required to work at both main locations in Orange and Irvine, and sometimes community sites depending on responsibilities and scheduling demands.
