jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Client Experience Coordinator (CEC) manages the client experience from the time an order has been released and acknowledged through installation, project completion, and closeout.

This role combines project coordination with proactive client communication. The CEC keeps clients informed, coordinates installation scheduling, prepares projects for installation, manages post\-installation issues and service items, and ensures consistent communication through final completion.

**Our objective:** Clients should always understand where their project stands, what happens next, and who to contact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Introduction \& Communication**

* Receive new projects from the Project Readiness Coordinator and review the complete project file before contacting the client.
* Introduce yourself as the client's primary Project Coordinator and establish expectations regarding communication and next steps.
* Maintain proactive communication throughout the remainder of the project and respond promptly and professionally to client questions.
* Personally communicate delays, changes, problems, or other exceptions rather than relying solely on automated communication.
* Document meaningful client communication within the CRM/ERP.
* Production \& Project Tracking
* Review manufacturer acknowledgements and anticipated product availability.
* Monitor project and product status and identify potential delays or issues that may impact installation.
* Keep clients informed of meaningful changes and coordinate internally with Project Managers and Operations when issues require attention.

**Installation Coordination**

* Coordinate installation timing based on product availability and operational capacity; schedule and confirm installation dates with clients.
* Create and complete installer packets and confirm required project and installation documentation is available.
* Verify projects are administratively prepared for installation and ensure clients receive appropriate pre\-installation instructions.
* Confirm upcoming installations and manage scheduling changes when necessary.

**Installation Support**

* Monitor project status during installation and coordinate with the Project Manager regarding installation progress.
* Receive documentation of missing parts, damage, service requirements, or incomplete work.
* Communicate promptly with clients when an installation is not First Time Complete (FTC) and establish clear expectations regarding next steps.

**Service \& Outstanding Items**

* Order required replacement parts or materials and track outstanding parts through receipt.
* Maintain accurate service and outstanding\-item records and coordinate return visits and service appointments.
* Keep clients proactively updated while outstanding items are being resolved.
* Work with Project Management and Operations to drive projects to final completion.

**Project Completion \& Closeout**

* Confirm completion with the client and conduct a post\-installation follow\-up call and/or email.
* Confirm client satisfaction and identify unresolved concerns.
* Coordinate final payment as part of project closeout and confirm all outstanding work has been completed.
* Request a client review when appropriate, complete all required closeout documentation, and formally close completed projects.

**CRM \& Automated Communication:**

The CEC is responsible for ensuring the CRM is used effectively to support the client experience. Automated communication may include production/project updates, installation confirmations and reminders, pre\-installation instructions, and appointment reminders.

Automation should supplement, not to replace personal communication. When a project falls outside the normal process, the CEC is responsible for personally communicating with the client.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer service and relationship\-management ability.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and accountable, with strong follow\-through.
* Ability to manage multiple active projects, competing priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable communicating difficult news, project delays, and changing expectations professionally.
* Strong problem\-solving, conflict\-resolution, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Comfortable working within CRM, ERP, scheduling, and project\-management systems.
* Ability to maintain composure and professionalism when managing escalated client situations.
* Experience in construction, home improvement, windows and doors, or another project\-based client service environment preferred.

Pay: $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**



Archipelago Companies, a portfolio of highly successful consumer lifestyle brands, is seeking a talented and passionate individual with an entrepreneurial mindset to join our team. Our brands, including OluKai, Kaenon, Melin, Roark, and Tradewind Services are leaders in their respective markets, offering high\-quality products and authentic marketing stories direct to consumers. At Archipelago Companies, we pride ourselves on our commitment to integrity, and we strive to create a culture of excellence in everything we do. If you are a driven and innovative individual with a passion for consumer brands, we invite you to apply for our open position and become a part of our dynamic and growing team.

 **About the Role:**



The International Distributor Account Manager owns the day\-to\-day commercial relationship with the distributor partners who represent OluKai, Melin, and Roark outside our directly operated markets. These distributors represent our brands in their local markets (i.e. Japan, LATAM, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, etc).

  

This is a cross\-brand individual contributor role that sits within Tradewind Services and is based in our Irvine, California office. You will be the commercial and operational center of gravity for an assigned book of distributor accounts: building and defending the seasonal forecast, driving prebook and at\-once order flow, tracking sell\-in against sell\-thru, and holding partners to brand standards in every market where they carry our labels.

  

We are looking for someone equally comfortable in a line presentation and in a pivot table, who can hold a partner accountable to a number without damaging the relationship, and who understands that in a distributor model your partner’s inventory position is your problem too.

 **Key responsibilities in the following areas include but are not limited to:**

 **Distributor Account Management**


* Serve as the primary day to day contact for an assigned portfolio of international distributors across all three brands
* Run the seasonal sell\-in cycle end to end: line presentation, market\-level assortment planning, prebook collection, order entry accuracy, and confirmation
* Manage at\-once demand and in\-season replenishment against available inventory, and coordinate seasonal samples, price lists, and asset delivery to partners
* Own the order book: monitor open orders, ship windows, cancellations, and backorders, and drive on\-time delivery in partnership with Planning and Operations

  


**Forecasting and Planning**


* Build and maintain rolling seasonal forecasts by distributor, brand, and category, and reconcile them to the annual plan
* Partner with Planning and Production on demand signals, buy quantities, and inventory positioning for the International channel
* Track sell\-in against sell\-thru by partner, and flag risk to plan early with a recommended course of action rather than a report of the problem

  


**Commercial Performance**


* Own revenue, margin, and order fill targets for the assigned book of business
* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly business reviews covering performance to plan, category and product mix, sell\-thru trends, open opportunities, and corrective actions
* Support pricing, terms, and margin discipline within approved guardrails, and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation
* Partner with Credit and Finance on payment terms, credit exposure, and collections issues affecting the book

  


**Brand and Market Stewardship**


* Hold distributors to brand standards for assortment, presentation, pricing integrity, and channel distribution in their markets
* Review distributor retailer lists, marketing plans, and go to market activity against each brand’s guidelines, and route brand asset requests appropriately
* Surface market intelligence (competitive activity, retail trends, product gaps, pricing pressure) back to the brand and product teams

  


**Cross\-functional Partnership**


* Work daily with Planning, Production, Operations, Customer Service, Credit, and the three brand teams to keep the distributor experience seamless
* Partner with Logistics and trade compliance resources on export documentation, freight, incoterms, and country specific requirements
* Contribute the International point of view to seasonal go to market and range planning

  


**Requirements \& Qualifications:**

  

* Four or more years in wholesale account management, international sales, or distributor management, in consumer products. Footwear, apparel, headwear, or an adjacent premium lifestyle category is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ownership of a revenue book with personal accountability for forecast accuracy and delivery to plan
* Working command of the wholesale seasonal calendar and how prebook, at\-once, sell\-in, and sell\-thru each move the order book
* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets) and the ability to build a forecast you can defend line by line
* Experience operating in an ERP and a BI or reporting environment, and the judgment to move from raw order data to a clear recommendation
* Clear, organized written and verbal communication with partners across time zones, languages, and business cultures
* Actively seeks out AI\-enabled tools and emerging technologies, adapting quickly to leverage them for improved productivity, deeper insights, and more effective processes, while exercising sound judgment and maintaining compliance with organizational standards
* A valid passport and the ability to travel internationally

* Experience with Full Circle, Domo, or comparable ERP and BI platforms

jobs.title: Evening Kitchen Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Evening Kitchen Operations CoordinatorPosition Summary**

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day production and fulfillment operations of the company’s kitchen, which produces in\-house food products for two retail store locations and specialty catering. This is not a chef or cooking position.

The primary focus of the role is coordinating purchase orders from the retail stores, supporting the kitchen production team, ensuring products are properly labeled and packaged, maintaining quality and accuracy standards, and helping ensure completed products are ready for timely delivery to each store.

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator serves as an important link between the retail stores and kitchen production team, helping ensure that orders are accurately communicated, produced, packaged, labeled, and delivered according to company standards.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Receive, review, and organize purchase orders and product requests from the company’s retail store locations to prepare for delivery.
* Communicate production needs and priorities to the kitchen production team.
* Track orders through the production process and help ensure products are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Coordinate the preparation of completed products for distribution to retail locations.
* Accurately label finished food products in accordance with company procedures and applicable labeling requirements.
* Verify product labels for accuracy, including product identification, dates, quantities, and other required information.
* Perform quality\-control checks on finished products, packaging, labeling, and order quantities before products leave the kitchen.
* Package and prepare products for delivery or retail distribution as needed.
* Compare completed orders against purchase orders to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain organized records related to orders, production, labeling, and fulfillment as required.
* Communicate shortages, production issues, quality concerns, or order discrepancies to appropriate management.
* Help maintain an organized and efficient production and fulfillment workflow.
* Coordinate with retail store employees regarding order status, changes, shortages, or other fulfillment needs.
* Transport products, supplies, or other company materials between the kitchen and retail locations as needed.
* Safely operate a company vehicle or authorized vehicle when driving is required.
* Follow company food\-safety, sanitation, quality\-control, workplace\-safety, and operational procedures.
* Maintain clean and organized packaging, labeling, storage, and work areas.
* Assist with inventory counts, supply organization, receiving, and other kitchen operations activities as needed.
* Provide hands\-on operational support to the kitchen production team as needed, excluding duties requiring a chef or specialized culinary role.
* Receive incoming deliveries.
* Perform other related duties as assigned based on operational needs.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in food production, manufacturing, fulfillment, retail operations, inventory, warehouse operations, or a similar environment preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to accurately quality control purchase orders, labels, quantities, and product information.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders and communicate effectively with both kitchen and retail teams.
* Dependable and able to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced food\-production environment.
* Basic computer, email, and data\-entry skills.
* Ability to follow established food\-safety, quality\-control, and operational procedures.
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required as driving is an essential function of the position.
* Bi\-lingual, English/Spanish is required.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical requirements described below are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Regularly stand and walk for extended periods.
* Frequently use hands for labeling, packaging, handling products, and performing other operational tasks.
* Regularly reach, bend, stoop, and move throughout kitchen, storage, and production areas.
* Lift, carry, push, and/or move products, boxes, supplies, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Work in and around a commercial food\-production environment, which may include exposure to hot and cold temperatures, refrigeration areas, food products, cleaning products, and production equipment.
* Safely enter and exit a vehicle and load or unload products when performing delivery duties.

**Work Environment**

This position primarily works within a commercial kitchen/food\-production environment and regularly interacts with kitchen production employees, retail store personnel, and management. The position may also involve periodic driving between company locations and performing duties at retail locations.

**Classification**

**FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt, Full\-Time. 3:30pm\-12:00am \- 5 days/week (Sundays required)**Reports To:** Kitchen Operations Manager

*This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties and responsibilities may be modified based on business and operational needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.*

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Title: ASLA Coordinator**

**HOW THIS ROLE SUPPORTS THE MISSION**

EOYDC’s After School Leadership Academy (ASLA) provides resources for K\-5 students to develop in the areas of academics, leadership, and character. Under the direction of the ASLA Manager, the ASLA Coordinator is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the ASLA program. These duties include, but are not limited to, supporting the design of ASLA curriculum, implementing lesson plans, training and managing the ASLA Youth Leader interns, assessing program outcomes, and building/maintaining relationships with participants, families, and partner schools.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

This role will collaborate across the organization, sometimes as the lead of a project and sometimes as support. The person in this role will be responsible for ensuring the success of the following:

* Development and facilitation of lessons, activities, field trips, and events that are consistent with the mission of the program for students in grades K\-5
* Creation and adjustment of weekly program schedule in consideration of partner school schedules and organization\-wide events
* ASLA student engagement
* Provide instruction based on engaging lesson plans developed to strengthen academic performance, enhance leadership skills, and develop character
* Supervise children and promote safety and respect amongst all participants
* Identify student academic and behavioral strengths and challenges, and work with the ASLA Manager and team to create appropriate plan to address their unique needs
* Work closely with students’ teachers and families to promote academic success
* Provide students with direct support to promote emotional/psychological health and development
* Establish two way communication channels to facilitate ongoing engagement with participants’ parents, guardians, and educators

**WHO YOU WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH**

This role is part of the ASLA Team, which works directly with EOYDC’s K\-5 students. Specifically, the following people will work directly with you to support your work:

* Your manager will help guide your work and be an advocate for you amongst senior leadership. They will also, with input from the Chief Program Officer, help you set the objectives and vision for the various activities that you will lead.
* Team Members: ASLA Coaches and Youth Leaders
* The Youth Leaders will work directly with the students on a daily basis and will provide you support by leading or supporting the activities that you plan
* The Coaches will support you as an additional layer of accountability for the youth leaders and will also provide support for large events

**WHO \& WHAT YOU WILL SUPPORT**

EOYDC’s collaborative culture means that everyone supports one another in achieving the organization’s goals. These are some of the ways you will support work that is led by others on the team:

* The ASLA Manager in:
* Identifying opportunities for program and process improvement
* Providing Intern and Staff support

* Reinforce program policies and procedures through role modeling, coaching, and performance management
* Assessment \& Reporting
* Maintain an individual development plan documenting goals, observations, learning outcomes, and progress for each student
* Maintain program attendance records and OFCY
* Provide insight to ASLA Manager on Program Monthly Reports
* Work with ASLA Manager to facilitate collection of program data for grant reporting purposes
* **Additional duties as required**
* EOYDC is a community\-based organization, and that community spirit shows up in how we work with each other. There may be times that are considered “all hands on deck,” and all team members are expected to jump in and support.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and experience equivalent to:

* Participation in/completion of a specialized program and/or pursuing a certification or degree in education, child development, or a related field strongly preferred
* At least 3 years working directly with elementary school and/or middle school students\-\-strong preference for at least one of those years being primary lead for classroom management and/or program coordination
* Demonstrated commitment to serving systematically marginalized communities with dignity and respect
* Highly organized with strong time\-management
* Must be patient, flexible, responsible, and enjoy being with students
* Must be available to work between 25\-30 hours per week, primarily on\-site during regular program hours
* Non\-profit experience preferred

**COMPENSATION**

This is a part\-time, temporary hourly position (25\-30 hours/week). The compensation is $23\-$27 hourly (depending on experience) \+ excellent benefits including health (health plan 100% employer\-paid), dental and retirement (starting 30% 403b match).

jobs.description:
**About the Team**

You will be part of a collaborative team responsible for creating elevated imagery to showcase our new and signature products. As part of Williams\-Sonoma, Inc., a leader in home lifestyle and retail, The Sample Coordinator is part of a Photo Team that drives customer engagement and profitability through compelling visual storytelling.  

**About the Role**

In this role, you will be responsible for organizing, transporting, and staging merchandise, props, surfaces, grip, crafty, and other supplies necessary to efficiently execute each shoot. You will be relied on by the Producer for any updates regarding product issues, supply shortages, equipment and truck maintenance, etc. We are seeking someone who is a self\-starter, detail\-oriented, and able to work independently and proactively to constantly support all facets of our photo teams while maintaining a can\-do attitude.


**Duties \+ Responsibilities:**

* Work with Producers daily to review what’s needed to execute photoshoots including — ordering and organizing merchandise and props, prepping surfaces, equipment, and crafty items.
* Understand the sample ordering/returning process to help organize and track merchandise before and after photoshoots.
* Unpack and carefully re\-pack photo samples safely for transit between photo teams, WS buildings, locations, and the warehouse.
* Unpack, check in, and test (if applicable) product before each shoot.
  

Save/organize paperwork/empty boxes, alert Producers of any issues with product, and note quantity received on sample tracker.
* Ensure all merchandise and props are returned with proper labeling and wrapping, alerting any issues immediately to the shoot’s Producer.
* Maintain, organize and update/document: prop cage, surfaces, sample inventory kept in studios, and studio crafty.
* Needs to be in Richmond location by 8:00am start time daily.
* Help construct and maintain various set and surface rigs on\-set.
* Assemble furniture pieces for photoshoot.
* Remain attentive and proactive to anticipate the needs of the photo crew on set.
* Drive 15’ and 20’ truck, and sprinter van (both require no special license).
* Vehicle upkeep: keep clean, keep insurance binders on hand, park in designated area at studio and notify Producers when they need maintenance.
* Travel occasionally with photo teams for photoshoot on location.
* Unload and reload trucks with merchandise.
Maintain a professional and respectful demeanor with the photo team, merchants, vendors, and homeowners.  
* 

**Required Competencies:**

* Ownership attitude – you’re happy to jump up to help anyone, finding samples quickly and rapidly change out sets, thinking on the spot for quick yet effective solutions in high pressure time constraints.
* Great time management skills – you’re able to work quickly while maintaining safety, prioritizing tasks, pivoting when necessary and staying calm under pressure.
* Extremely organized and thorough – you’re able to stage samples thoughtfully, troubleshooting samples for anything missing, broken, or defective and alerting Producers immediately.
* Anticipate needs – you’re always two steps ahead, listening so you can foresee and resolve issues early.
* Maintain an “all hands\-on deck” mentality to jump in to help where needed.
Sense of urgency when the task calls for it.

jobs.description:
#### **About Our Company**


WeBox is the leading intelligent marketplace delivering personalized group orders.  

WeBox is driven by three core principles: customers first, value the strivers, and build with partners.

  

### **Our Mission and Vision**


WeBox strives to deliver personalized group orders, ensuring that every group member enjoys the happiness of delivery.By 2032, we will achieve $1 billion in revenue by leveraging technology to become a leading provider of intelligent and sustainable solutions for group orders.


### **Job Summary**


WeBox, the leading intelligent marketplace for personalized group orders, is seeking a proactive and resourceful Logistics Operations Coordinator to join our team. This role ensures seamless delivery operations, focusing on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and efficiency. We're looking for someone flexible and tech\-savvy who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, manages last\-minute changes, and embodies our values of transparency, resilience, and accountability.


### **Core Responsibilities**


* **Route \& Process Optimization**: Provide support for route planning and identify key improvements to streamline delivery and sorting processes.
* **Driver \& Partner Support**: Train and assist drivers with our Driver App, troubleshoot and install printers, and provide vehicle management.
* **Corporate \& Onsite Support**: Offer on\-site assistance for corporate clients, support daily operations, and uphold food safety and quality standards.
* **Inventory \& Audits**: Conduct inventory management and daily audits, track materials, and support kitchen and equipment maintenance.
* **Team Development**: Assist with recruiting and training for sorting and driver workforce.
* **Quality Assurance**: Maintain and ensure compliance with quality standards and on\-time delivery (OTD).
* **Additional Tasks**: Perform other responsibilities as assigned to support operational needs.


### **Requirements**


* **Experience**: 2–3 years of delivery platform experience.
* **Professional Skills**: Team\-oriented, responsive, organized, with excellent customer\-facing and communication abilities.
* **Technical Skills**: Proficient in Google Workspace and project management tools.
* **Personality**: Professional, punctual, with an upbeat attitude and continuous improvement mindset.
* **Organization**: Detail\-oriented and consistent in reviewing work before delivery.
* **Language**: Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
* **With restaurant supervisor experience is a plus.**


### **Equal Opportunity Employer**


WeBox is an equal\-opportunity employer committed to hiring based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.


*Note:*


* *The base salary for this position will be determined based on the candidate's level of experience and qualifications.*
* *This job description offers a general overview and may not encompass all responsibilities, tasks, or skills required. Additional duties may be assigned to meet the company's evolving needs.*

  

  

If you meet the requirements and are interested in this position, please submit your application.

The Media, Entertainment and News team within Global Partnerships works with Google's largest Media and News partners to drive business and profitability through Google's platforms, products, and insights. This is a team based selling environment, where the CTV Account Manager works closely with buyside facing Account Managers, Product Management, Regional Product Lead (RPL) teams and other cross\-functional partners to support the sales efforts and day\-to\-day management across their book of business.


The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

* Propel go\-to\-market (GTM) strategy by encompassing 1:1 pitches, scalable offerings, and train\-the\-trainer programs, and partner with internal teams and support customer pitches to identify growth opportunities and drive business.
* Grow the CTV Network Package program across multiple functions, managing cross\-functional stakeholders effectively, participating in pipeline meetings, and tracking and reporting on results.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~15,000 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.  

Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

Keysight Device Security focuses on delivering advanced solutions for securing connected devices, ensuring compliance with global cybersecurity regulations, and addressing emerging threats such as post\-quantum cryptography challenges and semiconductor vulnerabilities. Our offerings include cutting\-edge security testing tools and professional security certification services tailored for silicon and firmware engineers, device manufacturers, and defense contractors.

* Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to contract closure.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure successful solution delivery and customer satisfaction.
* Stay informed about cybersecurity trends, regulatory requirements (e.g., Cyber Resilience Act), and emerging technologies like post\-quantum cryptography.


Qualifications:  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in account management or technical sales, preferably in cybersecurity or device security.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, compliance frameworks, and risk management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.

Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a global impact. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life — enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We equip our global teams with the tools and support they need to grow their careers while advancing science and delivering solutions to some of the world’s most pressing challenges, such as protecting the environment, ensuring food safety, and helping to find cures for cancer.


Location/Division Specific Information


This opportunity supports the Clinical Trial Division within the Pharma Services Group (PSG) at Thermo Fisher Scientific. Ideally, you will be remotely located in West Coast, US. Remote role with approx 25% travel in the territory.


How will you make an impact


We’re seeking a motivated and strategic **hunter** with a strong understanding of the life sciences industry. This hybrid role blends business development prospecting with early\-stage account management responsibilities.


What will you do

* Research, identify, and qualify opportunities with biotech companies needing Clinical Supply services
* Engage potential clients with targeted outreach and messaging to highlight the value PSG can bring to their projects
* Collaborate with AEs and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to evaluate opportunities and prepare internal teams with account intel and company summaries
* Coordinate the establishment of CDAs with new clients
* Support with internal setup of new accounts from both commercial and financial perspectives
* Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for a small portfolio of biotech accounts
* Gather information required to submit Requests for Proposals (RFPs) through Salesforce
* Leverage business intelligence platforms and internal digital tools to identify and advance new business opportunities


Education


Bachelors Degree required, Master’s degree preferred with 3\-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with demonstrated success in meeting/exceeding targets

  

Experience


Required: Ideally experienced in pharmaceutical, biotech, or CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisation) environments.


Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

* Strong prospecting and sales proficiency
* Self\-motivated, goal\-oriented, and proactive in delivering outcomes
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to relay project requirements clearly
* Highly organized; able to lead multiple priorities and experienced with Salesforce or similar CRM platform

jobs.description:
### **Who is Sonar?**



Sonar is driving the future of agent\-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI\-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.



Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI\-generated code.



We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent\-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI\-generated code via products like:


* SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
* SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
* SonarSweep \& Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise\-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.


Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:


* Committed to our customers and community.
* Obsessed with quality.
* Deliberate in our decisions.

Sonar helps prevent code quality and code security issues from reaching production, amplifies developers' productivity in concert with AI assistants, and improves the developer experience with streamlined workflows. At Sonar, we’re a group of brilliant, motivated, and driven professionals working hard to help supercharge developers to build better, faster. Sonar helps to continuously improve code quality and code security while reducing developer toil. This means that developers can focus on doing more of what they love and less of what they don’t. Our solutions don’t just solve symptoms of problems – we help fix issues at the source – for all code, whether it's developer\-written, AI\-generated, or from third parties.

We have a dynamic culture with employees worldwide and hub offices in the USA, Switzerland, the UK, Singapore, and Germany. Team members should be able to come to work every day, work on a product they are proud of, love what they do, and feel energized by their peers. With our roots deep in the open source community, we’re all about the mission: supercharge developers to build better, faster.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

Your impact will grow the usage of the SonarQube ecosystem within Accounts, both increase the value they get from our products and their consumption.

You objective are to increase the overall Account Sonar maturity, lower the risk of Account churn or downgrade, Increase Account satisfaction, reduce the number of escalations, Increase the number of Sonar sponsors in the Account, Establish and maintain Sonar as a Trusted Advisor in the Account, Entice Accounts to stay current on an Active version of Sonar, to get maximal value and Influence Sonar roadmap to meet Account needs.

In a nutshell, any technical activity that brings value both to the Account and to Sonar.
### **What You Will Do Daily:**

* Work on plans to overcome customer pains and inhibitors

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Blockit**
-----------------


Blockit is a Sequoia\-backed AI time agent.


It learns your preferences and can autonomously coordinate meetings to any degree of complexity (timezones, group scheduling, IRL, etc) similar to an executive assistant – but never goes to sleep and responds instantly.


Blockit is the foundation of a massive platform of AI agents that will have access to the world's time. The more people who continue to link their calendars to the agent, the more powerful our network becomes.

**Role**
========


Blockit is seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead activation, adoption, and retention across our customer base. We're looking for someone with 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions at a software company. Experience standing up a function rather than inheriting one is a plus.


You will personally work with every contracted account we have — today that's hundreds of accounts, heavily concentrated in venture capital, private equity, financial services, and professional services firms, alongside a fast\-growing base of AI and technology startups. You'll partner with our onboarding specialist to run pilots, fix problems, drive adoption, surface expansion signals for the rest of the GTM team, and be the voice that carries what they tell us back into the product.


Ideally, you are technical enough to figure out SSO or a broken calendar sync before you escalate it, commercially aware enough to recognize when an account is ready to grow, and analytical enough to write an SOP when a customer asks a usage question our dashboard can't answer yet. You are comfortable and excited by the speed of zero\-to\-one building in a startup environment and bonus points if you have a passion for productivity tools.


Our agent spreads virally, which means accounts land on you already curious and already using the product. Your job is to turn that curiosity into activated, deeply adopted teams — and to ensure the motion that lets the next ten people do it after you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Lead Enterprise onboarding, pilots, and rollouts end to end — setup, admin training, then adoption team by team: usage reviews with admins and chasing the pockets that haven’t linked calendars.
* Serve as the primary contact for inbound support and agent\-behavior feedback via email and Slack.
* Handle churn with a real save motion: understand why, offer the right landing spot, and harvest the reason.
* Build the machine: usage and retention reporting, templates, runbooks, and the QA loop behind our AI support agent.

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* **Accounts activate.** Within 90 days of close, most of an account’s users clear the value bar — five or more meetings scheduled. Account activation rate is the number you own.
* **Activation sticks.** Users hold that bar on a trailing 90\-day basis. First\-time activation is the start; sustained usage is the proof a team has actually changed how it schedules.
* **The product gets better.** A third of what customers write to us is a bug, a sixth a feature request. You turn that stream into prioritized input for product and engineering.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions. Founding or first\-CS\-hire experience is a strong plus.
* Technically curious and unafraid of the stack — you can hold your own with engineers.
* Comfortable with data and quick to learn. You know the difference between a number and a story.
* Commercially aware: you’ve read an account, known when it was ready to grow, and made the case with evidence rather than instinct.
* Exceptional writer — most of this job happens in email and Slack, in front of managing partners and heads of platform at some of the best firms in the world.
* Organized to a fault, with high agency and no ego about scope. Fifteen external calls, forty email threads, a bug queue, and a pilot scorecard only coexist if you have a system — and some weeks the job is a training session, some weeks a supplier registration portal at 9pm.
* Bonus: experience with horizontal productivity tools, or a network in venture capital, private equity, or professional services.

jobs.title: Manager 2, Data Science - Intuit Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).
* Lead and develop a world\-class team of analysts and data scientists, coaching technical and strategic skill sets, especially in advanced analytics, applied data science, and modeling.
* Translate business and analytics strategies into multiple short\-term and long\-term projects, and manage end\-to\-end execution, including the creation of a metric framework for expert experiences and developing learning plans that connect training and service investments to expert experience metrics.
* Activate analytics insights that lead to decisions or better hypotheses, and evangelize innovative analytics ideas that enable new opportunities.
* Drive analytics rigor by inspecting and improving experimentation methodologies and techniques, and creating a learning culture.
* Drive the data roadmap from data quality to data visualization, and construct data models that enable E2E service excellence measurement.
* Role\-model "win\-together" while challenging the status quo and driving change across teams, regardless of organizational structure.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of diverse analytics and data science experience, including product analytics and customer/expert experience analytics.
* Proven experience leading a team of analysts and/or scientists.
* Strong passion for uncovering strategic opportunities and solving business problems.
* Prior hands\-on experience with advanced statistical analysis, controlled experimentation (including A/B testing of hierarchical mixed effects), and applied data science.
* Prior hands\-on experience with Causal Inference methods (Propensity Score, DiD, Synthetic Control, etc.) and knowing when to use them to answer key business questions.
* Experience designing quality and experience metrics (e.g., NPS\-style scores, quality scorecards) and connecting them to business KPIs such as conversion and service time.
* Proficient with SQL and Python.
* Experience applying AI/ML and GenAI tools to accelerate analysis and workflows.
* Experience with data gap assessments, requirements gathering, and infrastructure implementation.
* Outstanding communication skills with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, etc.)

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

San Diego $189,000 \- $256,000

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesMarketing and CommunicationsID: 43019
  
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.


At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.


A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to join our and help bring influencer campaigns to life. This is an execution\-focused role built for someone who is highly organized, creator\-savvy, and eager to get hands\-on experience across all facets of influencer marketing — from day\-to\-day campaign coordination to supporting live events on the ground.



You'll work closely with senior team members to support a roster of creators, keep campaigns running on time, and be a key point of contact for influencers throughout their partnership journey. If you love being in the mix, thrive in fast\-paced environments, and take pride in getting the details right, this role is for you.


**You will****:**
-----------------


**Campaign Support**


* Assist in the end\-to\-end execution of influencer campaigns — supporting briefing, content review, posting coordination, and performance tracking
* Manage campaign timelines and deliverable trackers, flagging risks and keeping all parties aligned
* Partner with internal teams to draft creator briefs, talking points, and campaign recaps under the direction of senior team members
* Coordinate with internal teams (creative, legal, social, events) to ensure influencer content is on\-brand and delivered on schedule
* Pull and compile performance data from influencer platforms and internal dashboards to support weekly and campaign\-level reporting


**Event Support**


* Serve as an on\-the\-ground point of contact for influencers at live events — managing logistics, schedules, and real\-time needs
* Help coordinate influencer travel, accommodations, and event\-day itineraries in partnership with the events and operations teams
* Support event activations from pre\-production through wrap, ensuring creator experience is smooth and on\-brand
* Assist in capturing content moments and documentation at events for post\-event recaps and learnings


**Relationship Management**


* Act as a day\-to\-day contact for a defined roster of creators and their management teams, building trust and maintaining positive ongoing relationships
* Track creator deliverables, communicate deadlines, and follow up to keep partnerships on schedule
* Help onboard new influencers into the program — sending contracts, answering questions, and walking partners through the process
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in the influencer CRM, including contact info, campaign history, and relationship notes
* Monitor creator content, community sentiment, and platform activity to surface relevant updates to the team

**You have:**
-------------


* 3\-4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator relations, talent management, social media, or a closely related field
* A genuine understanding of the creator landscape — you follow creators, know the platforms, and can speak fluently about content trends
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball


**You are:**


* Clear, professional communicator — comfortable drafting emails to creators and their reps, and working cross\-functionally with internal teams
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can shift and no two days look the same
* Detail\-oriented and proactive — you spot what needs to happen next and take initiative to make it happen
* Familiar with influencer platforms, social media analytics tools, or creator CRM systems is a plus

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience supporting live events or experiential marketing activations
* Exposure to influencer contracting, gifting programs, or affiliate/commission structures
* Background in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech with knowledge of UGC creator communities
* Proficiency in Google Suite and knowledge of creator focused tools like Tubular, CreatorIQ, etc


For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**.

jobs.title: Technical Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Technical Inside Sales Representative**


**Location: T\&T Valve, 1181 Quarry Lane \#150, Pleasanton, CA 94566**


**Schedule:** Onsite \- Monday\-Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM with a one\-hour lunch


**About Bray International**



Founded in 1986, Bray International is a global leader in industrial valves, actuators, and control products. With customers in more than 40 countries and solutions serving over 12 industries, Bray delivers innovative, high\-performance flow control systems built on precision, reliability, and value.



As a privately held company with nearly four decades of engineered excellence, Bray combines the stability of an established organization with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a growing global manufacturer. Our reputation is built on quality products, exceptional service, and a culture that puts people—employees, customers, and partners—at the center of everything we do.



Our vision is simple: to be the most respected and successful valve, actuator, and controls company in the world.


**Position Summary:**



The Technical Inside Sales Representative serves as the primary contact for technically complex customer needs, including product specifications, technical quotations, order support, and return coordination. This role requires a strong technical understanding of the company’s product lines, the ability to provide guidance on product selection and configuration, and clear, professional communication with customers, Sales, Applications Engineering, Operations, and Accounting. The Technical Inside Sales Representative ensures customer requirements are accurately translated into quotes and orders, and works closely with internal teams to support successful order fulfillment and customer satisfaction.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Serve as a primary point of contact for customers seeking technical product information, quotes, or support.
* Respond to inbound calls, emails, and other customer inquiries promptly and professionally.
* Assist customers in identifying their technical needs and provide suitable solutions.
* Maintain and develop customer relationships to ensure repeat business and satisfaction.
* Prepare and send accurate quotations based on customer specifications, pricing, and delivery requirements.
* Ensure quotes align with current pricing models and guidelines.
* Track technical orders from inception through delivery, handling customer requests for modifications, status updates, or cancellations.
* Provide technical assistance to customers, explaining product features, specifications, and applications.
* Offer advice on product selection, customization, and configuration based on customer requirements and industry standards.
* Collaborate closely with outside sales, Applications Engineering, Operations, Warehouse, and Logistics teams to ensure products are delivered per customer requirements.
* Coordinate with manufacturers, regional sales managers, and other supplier partners to obtain technical information, pricing, lead times, and application support.
* Utilize available systems and internal resources to communicate accurate product availability and lead times to customers and sales partners.
* Enter and maintain accurate, timely customer information, order details, and sales activity in CRM and ERP systems to support visibility into quotes, orders, and customer interactions.
* Monitor and track open quotes and follow up with customers to win opportunities.
* Provide remote or in\-person training to customers on proper use, installation, and maintenance of products.
* Organize and conduct product demonstrations when required.
* Investigate and resolve customer issues related to product performance, order discrepancies, and technical challenges.
* Work with internal teams to facilitate product returns, repairs, or replacements in accordance with company policies.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest industry trends, products, and technologies through training, webinars, and internal meetings.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**


* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to explain complex products and solutions to customers.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* High attention to detail with the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficient in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize in a dynamic environment.
* Knowledge of industrial applications and process control systems is preferred.
* Experience with valves, pumps, instrumentation, heat systems, or other related technical products is preferred.

Through community presence and outreach efforts, the outreach coordinator will help connect individuals to the appropriate CCCS program and/or the MOIA hotline for free immigration legal services, referrals, or information. The coordinator will ensure that the community knows what services CCCS provides for immigrants and asylum seekers and how to access CCCS programs for free, safe, confidential legal services. This position is ideal for someone who feels comfortable engaging vulnerable communities and who is committed to the mission of supporting immigrant families.

**Job Description**
-------------------


Open to candidates who are permanent.
  

  

The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health, and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York's most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. DOHMH is mandated to inspect 26,000 restaurants annually, school cafeterias, and mobile food vending unit, adult day care centers, senior centers, soup kitchens, homeless shelters, and other facilities.
  

  

DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  

* Serve as a point of contact for al front\-end MFV customer service interactions, maintaining high\-quality care and effectively routing inquiries.
* Prepare and maintain various data and facility reports, logs, and tracking analyses to support informed decision\-making by the Regional Director.
* Provide customer care services through phone and in\-person interactions regarding mobile food vending permits and licenses, including guiding customers on required documentation.
* Assist in logistical planning and execution of operations, including scheduling appointments for Mobile Food Vendors pre\-permit inspections, and inventory control.
* Organize and host training sessions, ensuring designated facility space is available for administrative and custodial staff.
* Address inquiries from the Bureau’s Health \& Safety Coordinator and maintain compliance with health and safety regulations.
* Collaborate with Human Resources regarding personnel matters such as training and documentation.
* Work with the Director of Communications to ensure the facility has up\-to\-date literature and messaging for customer service needs.
* Support the Bureau’s Project Support Specialist with updates on vehicle usage and documentation.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Procurement Coordinator to monitor supplies and report any IT or resource issues.
* Assist with additional administrative duties and special projects as assigned to support the program.

  

PREFERRED SKILLS:
  

* Excellent communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Excellent decision making and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office
* Bilingual

  

Why you should work for us:
  

  

* Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
* Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:

o a premium\-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
  

o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
  

o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
  

o a tax\-deferred savings program and
  

o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
  

* Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.

\- Job Security \- you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.
  

  

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti\-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID\-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.
  

  

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

**POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. Working closely with Care Managers (CMs) and CM Managers, this role serves as a key operational resource \- triaging calls, coordinating with LTSS vendors, maintaining accurate clinical documentation, and monitoring eligibility and assessment data in New York State systems. This is a high\-volume, service\-oriented environment that requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to excellence in supporting vulnerable Medicaid populations.


This position is full\-time (40 hours/week) Monday \- Friday from 8:30 AM \- 5:00 PM. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.


If you are in New York state, you will have the flexibility to telecommute\* as you take on some tough challenges.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Administrative Support to the Clinical Team**

* Serve as an integral administrative partner to the NY MAP \& NYLTSS clinical team, providing day\-to\-day operational support to Care Managers and CM Managers to facilitate seamless delivery of LTSS to members
* Ensure required internal clinical documentation is accurately saved in each member's record; identify and report any documentation gaps or missing records to the appropriate clinical staff in a timely manner
* Review, organize, and disseminate Excel\-based reports to CM staff as needed to support care management workflows, caseload monitoring, and compliance tracking

**Member \& Provider Call Triage and Escalation**

* Triage inbound calls and requests from NY MAP \& NYLTSS enrollees, family members/caregivers, and LTSS providers, accurately assessing the nature and urgency of each inquiry
* Escalate member and provider issues to the assigned Care Manager or CM Manager in accordance with established NY MAP \& NYLTSS protocols, ensuring warm handoffs and complete documentation of the concern
* Document all interactions thoroughly within the care management system, maintaining HIPAA compliance and adherence to NY MAP \& NYLTSS record\-keeping requirements

**LTSS Vendor Coordination \& Service Gap Management**

* Collaborate with contracted LTSS vendors \- including home care agencies, personal care providers, adult day health programs, and other community\-based service organizations \- to confirm that authorized services are in place and being delivered to members
* Identify and communicate service gaps or initiation delays to the assigned Care Manager for timely resolution, ensuring members do not experience interruptions in their authorized LTSS
* Track and document vendor follow\-up activities, maintaining a clear record of service status and outreach efforts within the care management platform

**Eligibility \& Assessment Review in NYS Systems**

* Review member Medicaid eligibility status in New York State systems (e.g., ePACES) and flag any lapses, pending renewals, or changes that may impact LTSS service continuity
* Monitor assessment completion status in NYS systems (e.g., UAS\-NY), ensuring that required assessments are current and coordinating with Care Managers when follow\-up is needed
* Report eligibility and assessment discrepancies to the clinical team and escalate to the CM Manager as appropriate to maintain compliance with NYSDOH MLTC/MAP \& NYLTSS requirements


This is a high\-volume, service\-oriented environment. You will need to be efficient, productive, and thorough in supporting NY MAP \& NYLTSS members and the clinical team. You must be able to work a flexible schedule that may include evening hours. You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you, give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, and provide development opportunities for other roles you may be interested in.


You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

* 2\+ years of customer service experience
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Word (create, edit, and save documents), Microsoft Excel (create, edit, and save spreadsheets), and Microsoft Outlook (email and calendar management)
* Must reside in New York State
* Required to have a dedicated work area established that is separated from other living areas and provides information privacy
* Must live in a location that can receive a UnitedHealth Group approved high\-speed internet connection or leverage an existing high\-speed internet service

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within the health care industry and with health care insurance, particularly in a Medicaid, MLTC, or Managed Care environment
* Familiarity with New York State Medicaid systems including ePACES and UAS\-NY
* Experience working with LTSS vendors, home care agencies, or community\-based service providers
* Clerical or administrative support background in a clinical or managed care setting

jobs.title: Private Events Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Reports to:**

General Manager (dotted line coordination with Maître'd and Chef)

**Employment type:**

Part\-time — Hourly, non\-exempt, plus commission

**Schedule:**

Standard business hours, with regular evening and weekend availability required for client site tours and to attend events in progress

**Scope:**

Maxwell Alley private events (recommended initial scope — see note at end of document)

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Maxwell Alley is seeking a Private Events Sales Coordinator to own the full sales cycle for our private dining and event space — from first inquiry through signed contract — and to actively grow our events business through outbound outreach. This person is the primary point of contact for prospective event hosts during the decision\-making and booking process, with a hand off to our on\-site events team (Maître'd and General Manager) once a contract is signed. He or she remains financially and administratively responsible for the event through final settlement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Lead Management \& Sales**

* Respond promptly to all incoming private event inquiries — website intake form, email, phone, and other sources — with an acknowledgement the same business day, and a full response/quote within 36 hours.
* Maintain a single, up\-to\-date pipeline of every lead from first contact through signed contract, using Tripleseat software.
* Provide prospective hosts with everything needed to make a decision: availability, pricing, menu options, room capacity, layout possibilities, and decor/rental options.
* Prepare and send proposals, customized menu packages, and floor plans; recommend add\-ons (premium bar packages, florals, AV/entertainment, custom cakes, late\-night extensions) to grow average event value.
* Follow up consistently on open leads through a defined cadence until they convert or are closed out.
* Secure deposits and signed BEOs/contracts, and book confirmed events in Resy.

**Business Development / Outreach**

* Proactively prospect and generate new (“cold”) event business through targeted outreach — cold calling/emailing, list\-building (corporate offices, law firms, nonprofits, wedding and event planners), networking events, and referral relationships with planners and corporate concierges.
* Build and maintain a preferred\-vendor list (florists, bands/DJs, photographers, rental companies) for client referrals.

**Client Management**

* Meet prospective clients on\-site as part of their decision\-making process, including evenings/weekends as needed.
* Work along side the restaurant’s Maître’d to address client questions on room layout, decor, and other event logistics throughout the planning process.
* Adjust the BEO as event details change, keeping all stakeholders current.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Participate in regular pre\-event meetings with the on\-site events team (GM, Maître'd, Chef, Bar Manager) to review upcoming events and confirm details.
* Hand off confirmed events cleanly to the on\-site team, ensuring nothing is lost in translation.

**Performance Monitoring \& Optimization**

* On an ongoing basis, monitor conversion rates, ease and success of event execution, and other relevant business metrics.
* Collaborate with the GM to adjust event parameters (pricing, packages, minimums, policies, etc.) as needed to keep offerings competitive and attractive to prospective hosts while remaining efficient for restaurant operations.

**Financial \& Administrative**

* Collect deposits and progress/final payments per the contract schedule.
* Ensure signed contracts include cancellation/postponement terms, deposit schedule, and certificate\-of\-insurance requirements for any outside vendors.
* Close out each event financially: final invoicing, settling the bill, and return of deposit where applicable.

**Post\-Event**

* Solicit post\-event feedback from hosts.
* Flag repeat\-booking opportunities (annual corporate holiday parties, recurring galas, etc.) and re\-engage past clients on a proactive schedule.
* Track and report on conversion rate, booked revenue, and pipeline status on a regular (e.g., weekly) basis.

**COMPENSATION**

* **Base hourly rate:** $20–$24/hour.
* **Commission basis: Share of Event Admin Fee collected.**  Warm leads (inbound via website, email, phone, or other unsolicited contact): 33% of Event Admin Fee collected. Cold leads (sourced through this person's own outreach/prospecting): 67% of Event Admin Fee collected
* **Definition of “cold”:** a lead with no prior inbound contact or marketing touch, directly attributable to this person's own prospecting (cold call/email, networking, referral relationships)

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Prior experience in restaurant, catering, or event planning/sales strongly preferred. If none, other hospitality experience is required.
* Familiarity with Tripleseat or comparable event booking/CRM software.
* Strong math skills; comfortable calculating pricing, deposits, and payment schedules accurately.
* Proficient with Excel/spreadsheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — proposals and client correspondence are a core part of the job.
* Fluent English language skills required.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple events at different stages of planning simultaneously.
* Sales\-driven, client\-facing personality with strong follow\-through.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person
