jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Golden Steer is a digitally native food brand and restaurant company. We are anchored by the original Golden Steer Steakhouse in Las Vegas, a true dining institution as the oldest steakhouse in the city. What started as a single location restaurant has grown into two locations and a high growth eCommerce business where we ship our seasonings nationwide. We're scaling across channels, products, and geographies and we're building the team to match.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Golden Steer is hiring a Marketing Coordinator to be the operating engine behind marketing across all three of our businesses: our seasonings eCommerce line, Golden Steer Las Vegas, and Golden Steer New York. This is the person who turns the plan into shipped work. You will be the operational back bone, owning the marketing calendar, executing email, coordinating creative across paid and organic, while supporting restaurant marketing for both restaurants, and keeping every marketing initiative on schedule across three brands at once.

This is a senior coordinator seat. We are hiring someone who has already held this job, knows how the pieces fit, and is ready for the next rung. You will report to our Director of Organic Marketing. We are a small team and you’ll have an opportunity to work on several exciting projects that will set you up to have a big creative voice and eventually drive the direction of day to day marketing.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own one marketing calendar across all three brands, covering promos, product launches, restaurant events, and seasonal peak moments, with owners, dates, and dependencies the whole team can trust.
* Email execution for eCommerce \& Steakhouse. Sometimes that will require building one off emails, planning the schedule for sending. We have an email partner so the emphasis will be more on reporting back on what performed and what you would change.
* Creative operations. Write and route briefs, traffic assets into paid and organic, hold naming conventions in Motion and Meta Ads Manager, and work with our Content Coordinator to keep the asset library clean enough that anyone can find the right file in under a minute.
* Organic social coordination under the Director of Organic Marketing. Own the Social calendar across brands, coordinate posts with creative partners, schedule and publish, and keep community response times tight.
* Project\-manage campaigns and launches from brief through go\-live and post\-mortem. Build timelines, coordinate stakeholders, track deliverables, proactively flag roadblocks, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Paid media support. Keep trafficking, tagging, and QA airtight, pull weekly performance numbers, and flag what needs attention before it turns into a problem.
* Restaurant marketing for Las Vegas and New York. Local partnerships, reservations platforms, events, in\-restaurant collateral, and whatever the GMs need to drive covers.
* PR and influencer logistics. Press requests, sample sends, hosted visits, and content collaborations, coordinated end to end.
* Weekly reporting. Pull the numbers, put them in a consistent format every week, and surface the three things worth acting on.
* Post\-mortems. Every promo gets closed out with what we spent, what we made, and what we do differently next time.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**We're prioritizing skills in this order:**

* Execution (must be expert). You get things done, on time, without being chased. You take an ambiguous priority, break it into steps, and close it out. This is the most important thing.
* Organization (must be excellent). Your calendars, trackers, and files are clean and current. Nothing falls through, and the team can see status without asking you for it.
* Marketing judgment (must be capable, owned expertise). You understand why a campaign is built the way it is, you can read the numbers, and you have opinions. We will keep developing this with you.

**In addition, you should bring:**

* Real reps. 3 to 4 years in a marketing coordinator, marketing associate, or marketing operations role, ideally at a DTC brand, a hospitality group, or an agency serving them. You have run a calendar, sent the sends, and owned deadlines that mattered.
* Ownership without hand holding. You are given the outcome and you figure out the path.
* Comfort with numbers. AOV, ROAS, CTR, CVR, open and click rates. You can pull them, format them, and explain what moved.
* Range across brands. eCommerce, a Las Vegas institution, and a new New York restaurant have different customers and different needs. You can hold all three in your head in the same week.
* A genuine love of food and hospitality. You will be working inside two restaurants and a seasonings brand, and this should excite you.
* Flexibility. Restaurants and launches do not run on a 9 to 5\. Some evenings and weekends come with the territory.

**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU...**

* Have already done this job somewhere and are ready for the promotion.
* Are the most organized person on any team you have been on, and it shows in the systems you leave behind you.
* Move fast and close loops. Nothing sits untouched in your inbox for three days.
* Would rather ask a blunt question today than surface a problem next week.
* Get real satisfaction from making other people's work land on time and land well.
* Are comfortable executing within a small team but interacting with big senior leaders across lines
* Have an appreciation for the brand. We opened in 1958, the history matters, and every asset has to feel like us.
* Understand personas. On eCommerce our customers are largely suburban Gen X, Boomer, and Silent Generation home cooks, which is a different audience from the people booking a table in New York or Las Vegas.
* Like being in the room. This role is in person in New York, with periodic travel to our Las Vegas restaurant.

**TOOLS WE USE**

* CapCut
* Canva
* Sprout Social
* Google Analytics
* Shopify
* Klaviyo
* Motion
* Slac

jobs.title: Mid-Market SaaS Account Manager
jobs.description:
Within Operations, we are expanding our Digital Inside Sales (DIS) organization to accelerate growth in the SaaS, AI and digital solutions space. Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused SaaS Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.


In this role, you’ll serve as the primary commercial point of contact for your assigned accounts. You will build trusted customer relationships, understand each organization’s goals and AI strategy, increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and proactively address risks that could affect the customer experience or commercial relationship.

  

You’ll be responsible for developing and executing account plans, managing a healthy expansion pipeline, and coordinating internal teams to resolve customer needs. This includes identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across relevant products, features, use cases, and services.

  

This role is ideal for someone who combines consultative selling skills with strong account management, commercial judgment, and a genuine interest in helping customers realize measurable value from AI.

  

Responsibilities:

  

Account Ownership and Customer Relationships

* Own and actively manage a portfolio of existing customer accounts.
* Serve as the primary commercial point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned customers.
* Develop a clear understanding of each customer’s business priorities, AI strategy, use cases, organizational structure, and success criteria.
* Build strong relationships with customers across multiple levels, including users, champions, decision\-makers, procurement teams, and senior executives.
* Establish a consistent engagement cadence through discovery meetings, business reviews, strategic check\-ins, and proactive outreach.
* Create and maintain strategic account plans outlining customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, commercial potential, risks, and next actions.


Growth and Expansion

* Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within the existing customer portfolio.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, account activity, and business priorities to uncover expansion opportunities.
* Recommend appropriate products, features, commercial structures, and use cases based on the customer’s needs.
* Build and manage a healthy expansion pipeline while maintaining accurate forecasts and clear next steps.
* Lead consultative commercial conversations, including discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, negotiation, and deal progression.
* Partner with relevant sales teams when an opportunity requires additional commercial or technical expertise.
* Consistently achieve or exceed expansion revenue, pipeline generation, adoption, and account engagement targets.


Adoption, Retention, and Risk Management

* Help customers maximize the value they receive from the company’s products and services.
* Proactively identify accounts with low adoption, limited engagement, unresolved issues, or potential churn risk.
* Develop clear action plans to improve adoption, rebuild engagement, and protect the long\-term customer relationship.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products and use cases that support the customer’s evolving business objectives.
* Support renewal readiness by maintaining strong account health and ensuring commercial risks are identified early.
* Gather and communicate customer feedback, product gaps, competitive insights, and recurring challenges to internal stakeholders.


Customer Issue Coordination

* Take ownership of the customer experience when commercial, billing, product, contractual, or operational issues arise.
* Assess customer concerns, determine their business impact, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain clear communication with customers throughout the resolution process, including timelines, progress updates, and next steps.
* Escalate high\-impact or time\-sensitive issues through the correct internal channels.
* Ensure customer concerns are followed through to resolution while maintaining trust and accountability.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements that can reduce customer friction.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Renewals, Customer Success, Support, Solutions, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations teams.
* Coordinate internal resources to deliver consistent and seamless customer experience.
* Ensure clear handoffs, ownership, and accountability when multiple teams are involved in an account.
* Share customer insights and commercial opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Contribute to team best practices, enablement sessions, account reviews, and continuous process improvement.


CRM and Operational Excellence

* Maintain accurate and timely records of customer interactions, account plans, opportunities, risks, and next steps in Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Keep expansion opportunities, pipeline stages, close dates, and forecasts current and reliable.
* Prepare account updates and communicate progress, blockers, and support needs to leadership.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of product capabilities, pricing, commercial policies, customer use cases, and the competitive landscape.
* Follow established sales, contracting, forecasting, escalation, and customer communication processes.

  

Basic Qualifications

  

* Minimum of 4 years of experience in B2B account management, customer success, inside sales, or renewals.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience working with SaaS, AI, or cloud\-based solutions.

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Excellent executive level written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing mid\-market or enterprise custom

jobs.title: Account Manager, Hospitality
jobs.description:
**About Ande**  

We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  

We’re looking for an Account Manager to join the Supply team to support client success after they go live. That means retention, growth, and the kind of relationship that makes operators choose Ande for every new location and every new initiative. You'll sit at the intersection of revenue and relationship, monitoring health signals, running strategic reviews, and building the trust that converts a live account into a long\-term, expanding partner. You are the operator's advocate, their data interpreter, and the first person to know when something is off, or when there's an opportunity worth chasing.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the post\-live revenue relationship: manage adoption, retention, and growth across an assigned book of accounts, with accountability for product usage, Net Revenue Retention, churn, and expansion
* Execute a segmented coverage model, calibrating your time and depth of engagement to revenue impact across your book
* Run proactive lifecycle management: show up before operators know they need you, at the right moments in the account lifecycle, with the right context, before friction has a chance to settle in
* Monitor and interpret product signals: track leading indicators across usage, adoption, and revenue to identify at\-risk patterns before they become churn events
* Translate what you see in the data into a clear narrative, for the operator and for your internal team
* Drive expansion in partnership with Sales: surface upsell and expansion signals early, before the operator asks and before the AE has to chase, and bring the context that makes the handoff worth acting on
* Build champions who understand the value Ande is delivering and are willing to say so

**What We're Looking For**

* 3\-6 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client\-facing revenue role
* Someone who wants to work in an AI\-first environment, who actively looks for ways to use it to do better work, move faster, and show up sharper for their accounts
* Experience managing a tiered book of business with multiple account types, coverage models, and competing priorities at once
* Comfort with data; you know how to pull signals from a dashboard, translate them into a coherent narrative, and take action proactively
* A genuine bias toward proactive outreach over reactive firefighting; you're already thinking about the next touchpoint before the last one ends
* Cross\-functional fluency; you know how to work with Sales, Product, and leadership without dropping the ball or losing the relationship thread
* Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, MixMax, Claude, G\-Suite, etc., and a general comfort picking up new tools quickly

**Bonus Points**

* You've worked in hospitality, restaurant tech, or payments; you understand the operational rhythms of a venue and what actually moves operator behavior
* You have a track record of executing in ambiguous environments
* You've worked in a high\-growth or early\-stage company and know what it feels like when the process is still being written and your job is to help write it
* You've gone beyond managing to KPIs; you've helped define what good looks like, built the scorecards, and held yourself accountable to them
* You've used AI tooling in your actual workflow, not as a novelty but as a genuine lever for doing your job better

**Why This Role Matters**  

Every venue that goes live with Ande is a relationship that needs to be earned. You'll own that relationship: the retention, the growth, and the trust that makes operators choose us for the next location and the next product. You'll have real ownership over a book of business, direct access to leadership, and the opportunity to help build the CS motion as we scale.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

*Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will consider all applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected status.*


Compensation Range: $120K \- $150K

jobs.title: Social Media and Community Manager
jobs.description:
**Social Media and Community Manager** 

**About Our Client**

We’re a luxury skincare brand, devoted to targeted skincare solutions that address how skin cells age and how best to protect and revitalize the complexion and skin microbiome. Our products are sold direct to consumer via our brand website, Amazon, and at specialty retailers and spas, globally.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Social \& Community Manager to join our Marketing team and help build, engage, and nurture the communities that have formed around our brand. Reporting to management, you'll be voice of our social presence, creating meaningful content and a natural relationship builder who thrives in fast\-paced environments with a genuine passion for social media and connecting with people.

This pivotal role is perfect for someone who is eager to join an established, but small luxury skincare brand, helping to envision new and creative ways to engage, educate and inspire people about our unique products, and approach to healthy skin.

**What You'll Do**

* Content Creation and Social Media Support: Stay plugged into emerging trends and adapt / develop content quickly to capitalize on new opportunities
* Experience managing creators and partnerships, identifying and cultivating a selective community of creators (including dermatologists, aestheticians, and luxury lifestyle voices).
* Manage the creation \& posting of engaging, on\-brand content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, writing compelling captions and copy that reflect brand voice and drive engagement
* Build 30–60\-day content calendars aligned to product launches, skincare seasons, holidays, and cultural moments relevant to a luxury skincare audience; Use content scheduling and management tools such as Later, Sprout Social, or similar platforms. Collaborate cross\-functionally with creative, marketing, and product teams to align social content with broader campaign initiatives.
* Shoot and edit short\-form video content optimized for Reels, TikToks, and Stories
* Basic proficiency in editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or similar apps
* Reporting (weekly/monthly/YTD): Track and analyze social performance metrics and creator content performance against partnership investment in order to regularly optimize engagement, reach, and overall social presence.
* Reactively engage with users on tagged posts, comments, and mentions across all social platforms (collaborating with customer care as needed)
* Monitor and engage in general skincare, health/wellness and trending conversations where the brand can organically insert its voice
* Conduct ongoing social media research to identify how target audiences are discovering and engaging with luxury brands, \& content while building awareness of algorithm changes in reach and visibility.
* Create and execute strategies that grow and optimize the Affiliate Program (Impact, LTK, ShopMy, YouTube), supporting creator community, as well as select loyalty partners. Negotiate commissions, performance goals, and generate program reports (monthly/YTD).

**What You'll Bring**

* 3\-5 years of social media and community management experience, ideally with beauty, skincare, or luxury lifestyle focus.
* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a warm, authentic voice
* Strong multitasking abilities and comfort working independently across multiple platforms
* Proven relationship\-building skills and genuine enjoyment of connecting with people
* Experience in scrappy, fast\-moving startup environments
* Deep understanding of social media platforms and community dynamics
* Experience with analytics tools beyond platform tools, as well as scheduling, and creative organizational tools.
* You are an excellent communicator — a good listener who can empathize with our users, manage user feedback, be responsive, and oﬀer support so that we can improve the user experience for our community.
* Some experience in content creation (photography, graphics, video, and editorial/ visual skills) and scheduling content on multiple platforms
* Must have a basic understanding of editing social first content
* Passion for beauty, skincare and enthusiasm for learning on the job.
* Are a fluent English speaker and writer

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistent growth in community size and engagement across all platforms
* Positive social sentiment and strong brand perception
* Improved content engagement metrics over time
* Build/Deepen relationships between the brand and our most loyal customers
* Timely and effective resolution of community issues in partnership with the Customer Service team

**Tools \& Tech Skills**

Social medial platform tools: Meta business suite, TikTok Creator, YouTube Studio)

Content \& Calendar Management: i.e., Later, Sprout or similar tools.

Analytics tools: Platform analytics, Google Analytics, and ability to train on new platforms.

Design/Production: Proficiency/Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or similar apps

**Compensation**

Base Salary: $65k \- $90k \- Commensurate with experience.

Performance Bonus: This role is eligible for an annual bonus

Health, dental, \& vision: Employer contributed

Free Product Allowance: Quarterly allowance

Vacation Days

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern - Technical AI & Automation
jobs.description:
Eulerity is an AI\-native marketing automation platform. Our software runs paid advertising, social, listings, reputation, and call tracking for thousands of locations across enterprise franchises and SMB networks, executing autonomously across Google, Meta, Apple, and Microsoft. The Technical Operations team is the analytical engine that keeps that execution sharp.



We are hiring an intern to sit with this team for the summer.


**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------



This is not just a marketing internship. We are looking for someone who is genuinely analytical. The kind of person who opens a messy dataset and gets curious instead of overwhelmed. Who enjoys figuring out why a number moved. Who can read a chunk of SQL or Python and follow what it does, even if they would not write it from scratch. Who would otherwise be heading toward an analyst seat at a consulting firm or a product role at a startup.



If you love spreadsheets, you will feel at home here. If you have ever built a model in Excel just to understand something better, even more so.


**What you will actually do**
-----------------------------



You will work directly with our Technical Account Management and Analytics teams on the parts of campaign management that require thinking, not clicking. That includes:


* Diagnosing why specific campaigns are underperforming and proposing fixes grounded in the data.
* Building and refining Excel and Sheets models that our account teams use to make decisions.
* Auditing campaigns at scale, often across hundreds of locations for a single brand, and surfacing patterns no one else has noticed.
* Pulling, cleaning, and analyzing performance data from Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and our internal platform.
* Helping operationalize new analytical workflows, including ones we are building on top of AI tooling.
* Contributing to internal projects that make our team faster and smarter.


You will not be writing ad copy or designing creative. You will be doing the analytical work that makes the campaigns actually perform.


**What we want from you**
-------------------------


* Current student or recent graduate, ideally with coursework in something quantitative. Economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, math, finance, or similar. A traditional marketing background is not what we are looking for here.
* Strong Excel chops. Comfort with pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic, and building models from scratch.
* Basic code literacy. You do not need to be a programmer, but you should be able to read SQL, Python, or JavaScript and roughly understand what it is doing.
* Comfort with AI tools as a daily part of how you work. We expect everyone here to use them aggressively and intelligently, and you should be the kind of person who already does.
* Sharp written communication. You can take a messy analysis and explain the takeaway in three sentences.
* Detail\-oriented and self\-directed. You catch things other people miss and you do not need to be told twice.

**Logistics**
-------------


* Fall 2026, October start with potential to extend based on performance.
* Hybrid out of our NYC office, 2 to 3 days per week in person.
* Minimum 20 hours per week, flexible schedule.
* $18 to $20 per hour.
* Lunch credits and unlimited snacks when in\-office.
* Direct mentorship from senior operators on our team.

A highly innovative global corporation with a start\-up mindset, we empower every individual to make a genuine difference. jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** New York, NY
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevar

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


**Job Overview:**


FirstService Project Management (FSPM) provides project management and capital planning services to cooperative, condominium, and residential communities throughout the New York metropolitan area, helping boards and property managers navigate regulatory compliance, capital repairs, building system replacements, and major construction initiatives.


The Business Development Representative is responsible for identifying, developing, and advancing capital project opportunities within the FirstService Residential portfolio and the external marketplace. This role includes building and maintaining an organized pipeline, driving consistent outreach efforts, securing business development meetings, and delivering qualified opportunities to FSPM leadership.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify buildings likely to require project management support using property data, regulatory requirements, LL11/FISP filing cycles, inspection requirements, repair deadlines, and internal relationships.
* Track known and anticipated capital needs, including elevators, HVAC systems, roofs, garages, façades, plumbing risers, waterproofing, interior renovations, and building\-system replacements.
* Maintain a master database of FirstService properties, capital needs, deadlines, and FSPM engagement status.
* Utilize internal systems, public records, and meeting minutes to identify and prioritize project opportunities.
* Maintain accurate and complete CRM and business intelligence records, including next steps, responsible parties, and follow\-up dates for every opportunity.
* Conduct consistent outreach through phone, email, and approved communication tools to property managers, team leaders, and board members.
* Coordinate with property managers before contacting boards directly.
* Secure educational and business development meetings for FSPM leadership, positioning FSPM as a resource for compliance guidance, project planning, and risk reduction.
* Maintain persistent and scheduled follow\-up activities until opportunities are qualified, advanced, deferred, or closed.
* Re\-engage deferred opportunities at established intervals.
* Qualify opportunities based on project type, timing, scope, board readiness, consultant involvement, and funding considerations.
* Prioritize opportunities that do not have existing project management support.
* Escalate high\-value, time\-sensitive, or high\-risk opportunities to FSPM leadership.
* Prepare concise opportunity briefs, including known building conditions, project history, and regulatory deadlines before meetings.
* Transition qualified opportunities to the appropriate FSPM executive or representative.
* Advance opportunities through the sales pipeline from identification through meeting, proposal, award, deferral, or loss.
* Maintain current pipeline stages, opportunity values, probability metrics, and anticipated timelines.
* Coordinate with FSPM leadership regarding client engagement, proposal follow\-up, and recurring client concerns.
* Partner with Marketing to develop outreach campaigns and business development initiatives.
* Monitor and report activity levels, conversion metrics, and portfolio penetration trends.
* Support external prospecting efforts as the internal FirstService portfolio program continues to expand.
* Meet regularly with FSPM, Business Development, Marketing, Compliance, and Property Management leadership teams to coordinate opportunities and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate with portfolio managers, team leaders, and senior leaders to identify and advance project opportunities.
* Maintain continuity of opportunity information through property management personnel changes.
* Follow established standard operating procedures for outreach, qualification, escalation, and handoff processes.
* Practice and adhere to FirstService Residential Global Service Standards.
* Conduct business at all times with the highest standards of personal, professional, and ethical conduct.
* Maintain regular and punctual attendance at required meetings, training sessions, and related business activities.
* Participate in meetings and work groups to coordinate activities, communicate and resolve issues, and obtain approvals.
* Follow all company policies, safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.
* Perform additional projects, tasks, and related duties as assigned.

**Skills \& Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Real Estate, Construction Management, or a related field preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in business development, property management, real estate, or construction services preferred.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, or similar systems preferred.
* Experience managing databases, sales pipelines, and portfolio\-level opportunity tracking preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a large volume of opportunities, priorities, deadlines, and follow\-up activities.
* Persistent, disciplined, and professional approach to outreach and relationship management.
* Ability to build credibility and develop relationships with property managers, board members, executives, and prospective clients.
* Strong research, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to gather information, prioritize opportunities, and communicate effectively across stakeholder groups.
* Self\-motivated and accountable, with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment.
* Ability to communicate effectively about capital projects and building compliance topics without serving as the technical subject matter expert.
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* General property management, capital project, or construction knowledge preferred but not required.

**What We Offer:**

Overview:
**About the Role \& Team**
IDC is seeking a highly experienced and proactive Executive Assistant (EA) to support our CEO. This is a senior\-level role that goes well beyond traditional administrative support. It requires a professional who can anticipate needs, manage complexity on a global scale, and ensure seamless day\-to\-day operations. The successful candidate will be a trusted partner, enabling the executive to focus on strategic leadership. This role requires a high degree of flexibility and responsiveness, with the ability to support an executive whose schedule extends beyond standard business hours. This role is an individual contributor and reports to the Chief Executive Officer. This is a hybrid position based in New York City with travel to Boston every 2\-3 weeks for 2\-3 days.  

  

**What You’ll Do*** Manage complex and dynamic calendars, balancing priorities across global time zones.
* Anticipate needs and ensure the executive is fully prepared for meetings, presentations, and external engagements.
* Provide timely support and follow\-through during extended business hours, ensuring alignment with the executive's working pace and priorities.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion.
* Monitor, organize, and streamline email and communications to maximize executive focus and effectiveness. Communication \& Coordination
* Draft and refine correspondence, presentations, and briefing documents with clarity and professionalism.
* Serve as the executive's administrative liaison with senior leaders, clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate logistics for board\-level and client\-facing engagements, ensuring a polished experience.
* Collaborate regularly with the Chief of Staff to the CRO and other Executive Assistants across IDC.
* Plan and manage complex domestic and international travel with foresight, ensuring itineraries are efficient, practical, and aligned with executive priorities.
* Anticipate potential conflicts and proactively adjust schedules to minimize friction and maximize productivity.
* Prepare comprehensive itineraries and briefing materials that include logistics, meeting context, and key stakeholder details.
* Ensure seamless transitions between meetings, events, and travel segments, with a focus on keeping the executive prepared and effective.
* Coordinate logistics for leadership offsites, board meetings, and external events with a high degree of precision and professionalism.

* Maintain organized systems for documents, contacts, and records.
* Collaborate with internal administrative teams to ensure alignment and efficiency.

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator-Manufacturing
jobs.description:
**Purchasing Coordinator – Manufacturing**

Starflex Fabrication is seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Purchasing Coordinator to manage purchasing activities supporting our manufacturing operation.

This position will be responsible for the procurement of all materials, components, supplies, and consumables required to keep production running. The ideal candidate understands that purchasing in a manufacturing environment is more than placing purchase orders—it requires monitoring material requirements, maintaining supplier relationships, tracking deliveries, controlling costs, and communicating potential shortages before they impact production.

Experience in sheet metal fabrication or a similar manufacturing environment is a strong plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day purchasing activities for the facility, including:
* Sheet metal and plate
* Structural steel, tubing, angle, channel, and other raw materials
* Hardware and fasteners
* Welding supplies and consumables
* Powder coating and finishing supplies
* Shop supplies, tooling, and production consumables
* Safety and maintenance supplies
* Most general office supplies
* Review production requirements and MRP data to identify material and purchasing needs.
* Create, issue, and maintain purchase orders.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure materials arrive when required.
* Communicate material shortages, delivery delays, back orders, and other supply concerns before they affect production.
* Obtain and compare supplier quotations for pricing, availability, lead time, and freight.
* Collaborate with suppliers to maintain competitive pricing and reliable delivery performance.
* Coordinate purchasing requirements with Operations, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Accounting.
* Verify purchased materials and components meet required specifications, quantities, and revisions.
* Assist with resolving receiving discrepancies, incorrect shipments, damaged material, and supplier quality issues.
* Maintain accurate purchasing information, supplier records, pricing, and lead times within the MRP system.
* Monitor inventory levels of commonly used production supplies and consumables.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, improved lead times, supplier consolidation, and inventory reduction.
* Support supplier evaluation and purchasing documentation requirements associated with Starflex Fabrication's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.

**Qualifications**

* Previous purchasing, procurement, buyer, or material planning experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems required.
* Experience with ProfitFab is highly preferred.
* Sheet metal fabrication, metalworking, or structural fabrication experience is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with purchasing carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, structural materials, hardware, and manufacturing consumables is preferred.
* Ability to read and understand purchase requirements, part numbers, material specifications, quantities, and basic manufacturing documentation.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open purchase orders and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong supplier communication and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable obtaining competitive quotations and negotiating pricing, lead times, freight, and delivery requirements.
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general computer applications.
* Must be proactive and able to identify potential shortages or supply issues before they disrupt production.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

**What We Offer**

* Full\-time, hourly position
* 4\-day regular workweek: Monday through Thursday
* Overtime on Friday as needed
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance paid 100% by the company
* Life insurance paid 100% by the company
* Compensation based on experience

**About the Position**

This is a hands\-on purchasing position supporting a fast\-paced fabrication environment. The Purchasing Coordinator will have direct responsibility for ensuring the materials and supplies needed by Production are available when required.

Success in this position requires someone who takes ownership of purchasing requirements, follows open orders through delivery, communicates problems early, and understands how purchasing decisions directly affect production schedules, customer deliveries, and overall manufacturing performance.

Experience with ProfitFab and purchasing within a sheet metal or structural fabrication environment will be given strong consideration.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $26\.50 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator-Metal Fabrication
jobs.description:
Starflex Fabrication is seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Purchasing Coordinator to manage purchasing activities supporting our manufacturing operation.



This position will be responsible for the procurement of all materials, components, supplies, and consumables required to keep production running. The ideal candidate understands that purchasing in a manufacturing environment is more than placing purchase orders—it requires monitoring material requirements, maintaining supplier relationships, tracking deliveries, controlling costs, and communicating potential shortages before they impact production.



Experience in sheet metal fabrication or a similar manufacturing environment is a strong plus.



\*\*Key Responsibilities



\*\*


* Manage day\-to\-day purchasing activities for the facility, including:
* Review production requirements and MRP data to identify material and purchasing needs.
* Create, issue, and maintain purchase orders.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure materials arrive when required.
* Communicate material shortages, delivery delays, back orders, and other supply concerns before they affect production.
* Obtain and compare supplier quotations for pricing, availability, lead time, and freight.
* Collaborate with suppliers to maintain competitive pricing and reliable delivery performance.
* Coordinate purchasing requirements with Operations, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Accounting.
* Verify purchased materials and components meet required specifications, quantities, and revisions.
* Assist with resolving receiving discrepancies, incorrect shipments, damaged material, and supplier quality issues.
* Maintain accurate purchasing information, supplier records, pricing, and lead times within the MRP system.
* Monitor inventory levels of commonly used production supplies and consumables.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, improved lead times, supplier consolidation, and inventory reduction.
* Support supplier evaluation and purchasing documentation requirements associated with Starflex Fabrication's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.


\*\*Qualifications



\*\*


* Previous purchasing, procurement, buyer, or material planning experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems required.
* Experience with ProfitFab is highly preferred.
* Sheet metal fabrication, metalworking, or structural fabrication experience is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with purchasing carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, structural materials, hardware, and manufacturing consumables is preferred.
* Ability to read and understand purchase requirements, part numbers, material specifications, quantities, and basic manufacturing documentation.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open purchase orders and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong supplier communication and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable obtaining competitive quotations and negotiating pricing, lead times, freight, and delivery requirements.
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general computer applications.
* Must be proactive and able to identify potential shortages or supply issues before they disrupt production.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.


\*\*What We Offer



\*\*


* Full\-time, hourly position
* 4\-day regular workweek: Monday through Thursday
* Overtime on Friday as needed
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance paid 100% by the company
* Life insurance paid 100% by the company
* Compensation based on experience


\*\*About the Position



\*\*



This is a hands\-on purchasing position supporting a fast\-paced fabrication environment. The Purchasing Coordinator will have direct responsibility for ensuring the materials and supplies needed by Production are available when required.



Success in this position requires someone who takes ownership of purchasing requirements, follows open orders through delivery, communicates problems early, and understands how purchasing decisions directly affect production schedules, customer deliveries, and overall manufacturing performance.



Experience with ProfitFab and purchasing within a sheet metal or structural fabrication environment will be given strong consideration.



You should be proficient in:


* 5 Why (Root Cause Analysis Method)
* ERP \& MRP Systems
* Hardware/Consumables/Shop Supplies
* Raw Material Procurement


Machines \& technologies you'll use:


* MRP/ERP Systems, ProfitFab

Strong clinical sales acumen

jobs.description:

**Location: Atlanta, GA**

 **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Successful candidates will work in collaboration with the Omni Sales Team, Sales Planning, and Supply Chain to develop sustainable growth strategies. This role will provide guidance and support in developing and achieving Newell’s strategies for assigned category. **Responsibilities:**

* Leverage category development management, customer planning, commercial finance, and customer supply chain resources in the development and activation of customer category business plans.
* Analyze business trends and ideates on ways to drive the business – collaborates with cross functional team on the tactics

* Present plans, recommendations, initiatives to customer to gain approval
* Leverage category and consumer insights to build customer\-centric recommendations to sales growth.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business or similar field required, MBA is a plus
* Minimum 5\+ years of direct and hands\-on experience in sales
* Experience working in a Consumer\-Packaged Goods (CPG), Fast\-Moving Consumer Good (FMCG) and/or consumer durables industry strongly preferred

jobs.description:

**Who We Are**


OWL Services is the premier sales, installation, program management and service provider to retail, commercial, fleet, aviation and marine, EV Charging, and emergency power generation companies across the U.S.


With 33 offices and distribution centers and more than 1,400 field service professionals, OWL delivers on a service platform that includes construction, compliance and testing, maintenance and repair, modernization and re\-imaging, and EV charging solutions to keep businesses and people moving 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.


OWL Services’ companies have received numerous awards over the years for exemplary customer service. Most recently it was the recipient of EVgo’s Deployment Excellence Award in its first\-ever class of awardees in the National EV Charging Recognition Program.


Come join us! For more information visit OWLServices.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

**The Role:**


We are seeking a dynamic and hardworking **Sales Representative** to join our team and drive growth within the **petroleum service industry**. This individual will be responsible for developing, leading, and executing sales strategies that expand our market presence in Georgia \& Alabama, strengthen customer relationships, and position OWL Services as a trusted partner. The ideal candidate brings experience selling petroleum\-related products/services and has a strong understanding of customer operations in this space. This is a long\-term career opportunity with a growing company.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify new business opportunities by targeting prospects, evaluating their needs, and understanding their role within the industry.
* Use a consultative sales approach to understand customer operations, challenges, and future needs.
* Determine requirements for new products and services and introduce solutions that support customer goals.
* Maintain outstanding customer service levels while providing continuous support, information, and timely resolution to issues.

* Keep customers updated on equipment, technology, and service enhancements.
* Maintain accurate and organized customer files, including contact details, proposals, and promotional activity.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor offerings, and market activity to identify opportunities for growth or differentiation.
* Recommend strategies that strengthen our market position and address emerging customer needs.

* 2\+ years of sales experience in petroleum industry
* Proven success growing accounts or managing a sales territory
* Knowledge of petroleum equipment or fuel systems preferred
* Strong communicator with excellent listening and customer service skills
* Entrepreneurial, self\-motivated, and able to work independently
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and highly professional

jobs.description:
**We Put the World on Vacation**


Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. **This is a fully virtual work from home sales position for candidates who reside in the states of Florida, Georgia and South Carolina only. Candidates who reside outside of these states will not be considered.** Successful candidates must be able to meet our work at home requirements (see below).

**How You'll Shine:**


Are you passionate about travel and skilled in sales? Join our team as a Travel Sales Representative with Travel \+ Leisure! In this role, you’ll combine your love for customer service with your sales expertise to create unforgettable travel experiences for our clients. Here’s what you’ll do:

**Sales and Customer Service:** Take inbound calls from excited customers ready to plan their dream vacations. Your expertise will guide them through the booking process for car rentals, airfare, hotel reservations, cruises and local experiences.

**Subject Matter Expertise:** As a **Travel Sales Representative,** you’ll be the go\-to resource for our customers. Build rapport and recommend personalized, lifestyle\-aligned travel solutions—air, hotel, cruise, car, and local experiences—curated for each customer.

* **$17\.50 per hour plus monthly sales incentives based off your performance**
* **Start Date: Friday October 16th**

**What You'll Bring:**

* **Proven Sales Experience:** Demonstrated success in driving results through inbound service, outbound follow\-up, and relationship\-based selling.
* **Exceptional Interpersonal Skills:** Quickly establish rapport with customers, engage in meaningful conversations, and create lasting connections. You’ll ask probing questions to understand their travel needs and seamlessly offer additional services.
* **Strong Multitasking Abilities:** Thrive under pressure and handle multiple tasks effectively.
* **Education Requirement:** High School Diploma or GED is required.
* **Customer Service and Sales Experience:** Six months of experience in both areas.
* **Travel Experience Preferred:** Six months of travel\-related experience is a plus.
* **Technology Agility:** Comfortable managing several technology applications simultaneously (CRM, booking tools, payment systems, communication apps). Prior travel software knowledge (e.g., Amadeus, Apollo, Sabre, Worldspan) is helpful but not required; ability to learn quickly is essential.
* **Training Schedule:** A 5\-week training schedule from 11:00 am to 8:00 pm EST.
* **Post\-Training Availability:** Be available to work between 8:00 am and 10:00 pm EST Monday to Saturday with a set schedule provided.
* **Holiday Availability:** Ability to work some holidays.

**What is required for me to work from home?**

* Quiet workplace free of distractions and background noise
* High speed internet requirements Download speed of 20 mbps and upload speed of 3 mbps average ping below 100m
* Must be able to hardwire computer directly to a router
* Must have own personal device with a working camera to be used for the first week of training (until our computers reach your home)
* Intermediate computer proficiency and ability to troubleshoot technical issues while at home

**So what are you waiting for? Apply today to start your next career journey with Travel \& Leisure—where you’ll deliver not just trips, but unforgettable, concierge\-level experiences for every customer!**

 **How You'll Be Rewarded:**


We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include:


***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.***

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life and accident coverage
* Disability
* Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
* 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Legal and identify theft plan
* Voluntary income protection benefits
* Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
* Employee Assistance Program

 **Where Memories Start with You**


Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**



Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Our Mid\-Market Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long\-term partner.



You'll manage a portfolio of 100\-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid\-Market your reach and prioritize where you spend your time. You won't shy away from rolling up your sleeves on integrations and the more technical aspects of the Samsara platform — you'll learn, understand, and convey the value of our most complex products and features.



Your role will be cross\-functional, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper\-growth company from within. The Mid\-Market CS team is still being built, and you'll help write its next chapter — shaping the playbooks, workflows, and AI\-powered motions that define how we Mid\-Market.


**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.**  


**You should apply if:**
* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
* **You thrive the most when solving problems:** Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevard

jobs.description:
**Join the Family** \- Come work for an exciting company offering great benefits, challenging opportunities, and colleagues who feel more like family.

**Job Summary**


Austin Powder is seeking a Business Development Representative focused on new business development to accelerate revenue growth across construction, quarry, and industrial blasting markets. This role is responsible for identifying, qualifying, and securing new accounts while converting customers to APC’s preferred product and service offerings, including emulsions, electronic initiation systems, technical solutions and blasting services.  

  

This position will execute APC’s commercial strategy through outbound prospecting, structured pipeline management, and value\-based selling. The role requires strong commercial acumen, disciplined lead generation, and rigorous execution of APC’s sales process to grow market share and develop customer relationships into long\-term partnerships. The Business Development Representative will report to the Regional Sales Manager or LLC President / VPGM.**Key Responsibilities and Duties**

**New Business Generation**

* Identify, prospect, and secure new customer accounts across assigned territory.
* Build strong relationships at both operational and executive levels within targeted organizations.
* Maintain a robust pipeline with documented next steps, probability ratings, and clear timeframes.
* Meet or exceed new account revenue and gross margin targets.

**Commercial Strategy \& Account Activation**

* Conduct site visits to assess customer operations, understand use cases, and position APC’s value proposition.
* Lead preparation of proposals, ROI discussions, and competitive bids.
* Guide customers through onboarding and product/service adoption, in coordination with technical and field service teams.
* Support contract negotiation in alignment with pricing guidance and margin targets.

**Market \& Competitive Intelligence**

* Monitor market trends, competitor actions, and customer buying behaviors in construction, quarrying, and related sectors.
* Communicate field insights to Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Product teams to inform commercial strategy.
* Identify emerging opportunities for expansion into new territories, applications, and customer segments.

**CRM \& Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM entries across all opportunities, activities, and contact records.
* Ensure pipeline discipline and forecast accuracy in accordance with APC’s sales process.
* Support adoption of new CRM workflows and reporting tools as part of APC’s commercial transformation.

**Sales Enablement \& Training**

* Utilize sales enablement tools, including playbooks, training modules, and product knowledge resources.
* Keep current on APC’s product portfolio, including specialty detonators, emulsions, packaged explosives, technical solutions, and blasting services.
* Participate in safety and technical training sessions to enhance customer credibility and support safe operations.

**Safety, Compliance \& Operational Alignment**

* Adhere to all APC policies and safety regulations, including ATF, MSHA, OSHA, DOT, and relevant federal/state guidelines.
* Complete all required certifications and maintain professional standards consistent with explosives industry expectations.
* Work closely with field services to ensure alignment of product delivery, blast schedules, and customer support.

**Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate with Marketing to support lead generation and campaign execution.
* Partner with Technical Services and Product Specialists to address customer challenges and demonstrate APC solutions.
* Work with Finance and Operations to ensure accurate revenue tracking, delivery scheduling, and credit management.

**Brand Advocacy \& Market Presence**

* Serve as an external ambassador for the APC brand, representing the company at industry associations, trade shows, conferences, and regional events.
* Proactively engage in outbound marketing and lead\-generation activities to expand APC’s visibility and credibility in target markets.
* Strengthen APC’s reputation by delivering consistent, professional messaging aligned with corporate positioning and commercial strategy.

***Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities***

**Core Knowledge \& Business Acumen**

* Maintain strong understanding of explosives applications, customer production cycles, and key industry drivers.
* Develop working knowledge of pricing models, margin expectations, and cost\-to\-serve considerations.
* Represent APC’s brand, values, and professionalism in all customer engagements.

**Core Competencies**

* **Hunter Sales Mindset:** Demonstrated ability to prospect, qualify, and close new business.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation skills, ability to articulate value, and comfort navigating extended buying cycles and complex customer decision\-making structures.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Ability to learn blasting fundamentals, product specifications, relevant software tools and applications, and regulatory requirements.
* **Execution Discipline:** Proficient in CRM use, pipeline management, and structured sales processes.
* **Communication Excellence:** Clear written and verbal communication across customer, technical, and leadership audiences.
* **Resilience \& Adaptability:** Thrives in field\-based, fast\-paced environments; persistent and self\-motivated.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively across Sales, Operations, Field Services, and Marketing teams.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred; High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* 3–5\+ years of experience in **outbound sales, business development, or technical industrial sales.**
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel extensively within assigned territory.
* Strong CRM proficiency and familiarity with structured sales processes.

jobs.title: Retail Sales Representative
jobs.description:
TCC, Verizon Authorized Retailer \- Retail Sales Representative
  
At TCC, Verizon Authorized Retailer, we believe our communities need more than just a wireless retailer, and our employees want more than just a job. We are committed to making a positive and sustainable impact in the lives of our employees, customers, and communities.
  
  

When you bring your energy, passion, and commitment to our customers and communities, we believe your success should match your effort—that’s where our pay comes in. With an uncapped commission structure, generous monthly bonuses, and an annual profit\-sharing bonus, your earning potential is truly unlimited for those who are motivated to win. If you’re ready to take control of your income and build a rewarding career, we can’t wait to see what you bring to the team—apply today!
  
  

Pay
  
* Average Salary: $55\-65,000 per year
* Salary Includes: Competitive Hourly Rate, Uncapped Commission, Bonuses and Profit Sharing
* Hourly Guaranteed Pay
* Same Day Pay Options


Day in the Life
  
A typical day at TCC as a Sales Associate starts with purpose. From opening the store to welcoming each customer, the focus goes beyond selling—it’s about building connections, understanding needs, and delivering solutions that truly make a difference. Every interaction, whether in\-store or over the phone, is an opportunity to create value, build trust, and exceed expectations.
  
  

Success is driven by a balance of strong sales performance and genuine customer care. Supported by ongoing training, collaboration, and growth opportunities, each day contributes to developing the skills needed for a long\-term career. And through community involvement, the impact of the role extends far beyond the store.
  
  

Benefits
  
* Career Development
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Community Time
* Paid Employees Matter Day
* Generous Community Grant Opportunities
* Employee Resource Groups
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* 401K with Company Match
* Long\-Term and Short\-Term Disability
* Critical and Accident Benefits
* Family Related Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee Referral Program
* Verizon Wireless Discount Options
* Rewards and Recognition


Do you have…
  
* Telecommunication or wireless sales experience
* Experience working in a fast\-paced wireless retail sales position
* Energized by a competitive, goal\-driven sales environment where performance is rewarded


Qualifications
  
* At least a high school diploma.
* Ability to work guaranteed full\-time hours.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* Ability to work in a retail, storefront environment
* Reliable transportation. This position may require the ability to work in multiple locations.
* Requires frequent standing and the ability to stand, sit, walk, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Ability to lift 10 pounds as needed.
* Ability to travel is approximately 10%, based on the needs of the business.
* Legally authorized to work in the U.S.


TCC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to celebrating our employees' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status.
  
  

A job for which military candidates are encouraged to apply.
