* Plan and execute meeting logistics, including conference room reservations, catering, presentation materials, and technology support.
* Support team operations, including facilities coordination, invoice processing, and other administrative activities that contribute to a productive workplace.
* Coordinate logistics for team events, training programs, leadership meetings, town halls, and special projects.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the company to facilitate collaboration, problem\-solving, and effective executive support.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and leverage technology, including AI\-enabled tools, to enhance efficiency and team effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* At least five (5\) years of Executive Assistant experience supporting senior executives in a large, fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Demonstrated expertise managing highly complex executive calendars with significant scheduling volume and competing priorities.
* Experience supporting senior\-level leaders and interacting regularly with executive offices.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Proven ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Self\-starter who can work independently with minimal direction.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and resourcefulness.
* Proven ability to build effective working relationships across a large organization.
* Experience coordinating domestic and international travel arrangements and expense reporting.
* Experience supporting meetings, events, and executive presentations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Comfort supporting a global organization and working across multiple time zones.
* Strong customer\-service mindset and commitment to executive excellence.

* Proven knowledge of enterprise Disney processes, structure, and practices
* Working knowledge of programs such as SAP, COUPA, Airtable, Concur, Loop, and AI platforms
* Administrative experience in a corporate environment with proven success interacting, partnering, and networking with all levels of management, including executives (directors and vice presidents) in a fast\-paced dynamic environment

**Education**

* High School Diploma or equivalent work experience

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News \& World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second\-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  

  

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.
The UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR) is driven to improve health and wellness of people in Orange County and the world by providing life\-saving clinical trials designed to strengthen and accelerate the pathway of discovery from the medical laboratory to the clinic.  


Responsibilities:

Independently or under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, and the Assistant Director of Clinical Research Operations, the incumbent leads the day\-to\-day execution of assigned clinical trials in the UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR). Serving as primary coordinator on trials of varying complexity, the incumbent is accountable for accurate execution, documentation, and communication for comprehensive coordination and data management of complex phase I – IV clinical research protocols from initiation through close\-out of research projects with human subjects. The incumbent operates in an interdisciplinary model across multiple therapeutic areas. This position facilitates all implementation phases of new clinical research studies as well as the ongoing coordination and maintenance of open and closed studies. Incumbent will conduct interviews with study patients in the clinic, screen participants, facilitate patient care, and collect data in compliance with established study protocols. The incumbent will receive appropriate onboarding and training to ensure proper preparation for this role as well as ongoing training where appropriate.
  

  

Develop and establish process for review and oversight of clinical trials conducted by investigators and ensure study protocols are followed, appropriate documentation is kept, and accurate data is collected according to Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/ International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, internal standard operating procedures (SOPs), FDA regulations, and University policies and procedures. This position plays a key role in assisting the Principal Investigator (PI) in recruiting patients for clinical studies and meeting enrollment and retention goals.
  

  

Complete timely and accurate collection and coordination of data submission to study sponsors ensuring quality control and leading to timely milestone payments. This includes responsibility for the compilation and transcription of research patient data and study\-related information into case report forms (CRFs) into sponsor specific electronic data capture systems (EDC). S/he will work with the clinical research team to manage and collect accurate data and assist Principal Investigators and study coordinators for all data management aspects of non\-cancer related trials.
  

  

The incumbent is also responsible for maintaining communication with all elements of a multi\-level research network, interacting with sponsoring agencies and compliance and regulatory groups such as the Institutional Review Board (IRB), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and sponsor monitors. This individual will interact with subjects, clinic and research staff, laboratory staff, radiology staff and any other medical professionals associated with our clinical research protocols. In addition, this individual must maintain clinical trial information in the clinical trial management system (OnCore) and adhere to institutional policies.
  

  

The main CCR offices and clinics are located at the UCI Medical Center in Orange and the UCI campus in Irvine, as well as various clinics at community sites throughout Orange County. The incumbent will be required to work at both main locations in Orange and Irvine, and sometimes community sites depending on responsibilities and scheduling demands.

* Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload and adapt to a rapidly changing work environment
* Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job; ability to interact with patients and caregivers in a compassionate and empathetic manner
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
* Proven ability to research, properly evaluate information, and prepare clear, concise and well\-organized reports, summaries, and correspondence; ability to think critically, compile data from various sources, analyze and synthesize data/information and present it to others in a clear and concise way
* Proven organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to multi\-task, prioritize a complex and dynamic workload, meet rigid deadlines despite interruptions, frequent workload changes and competing demands, and achieve high productivity/quality within short time frames; skill in working independently, taking initiative and following through on assignments and ability to work as part of a team
* Proven ability to analyze and solve problems, implement solutions, and resolve concerns that arise unexpectedly; proactive problem\-solving abilities and follow through
* Proven ability to independently exercise discretion and sound judgment
* High level of integrity and honesty in maintaining confidentiality

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Blockit**
-----------------


Blockit is a Sequoia\-backed AI time agent.


It learns your preferences and can autonomously coordinate meetings to any degree of complexity (timezones, group scheduling, IRL, etc) similar to an executive assistant – but never goes to sleep and responds instantly.


Blockit is the foundation of a massive platform of AI agents that will have access to the world's time. The more people who continue to link their calendars to the agent, the more powerful our network becomes.

**Role**
========


Blockit is seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead activation, adoption, and retention across our customer base. We're looking for someone with 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions at a software company. Experience standing up a function rather than inheriting one is a plus.


You will personally work with every contracted account we have — today that's hundreds of accounts, heavily concentrated in venture capital, private equity, financial services, and professional services firms, alongside a fast\-growing base of AI and technology startups. You'll partner with our onboarding specialist to run pilots, fix problems, drive adoption, surface expansion signals for the rest of the GTM team, and be the voice that carries what they tell us back into the product.


Ideally, you are technical enough to figure out SSO or a broken calendar sync before you escalate it, commercially aware enough to recognize when an account is ready to grow, and analytical enough to write an SOP when a customer asks a usage question our dashboard can't answer yet. You are comfortable and excited by the speed of zero\-to\-one building in a startup environment and bonus points if you have a passion for productivity tools.


Our agent spreads virally, which means accounts land on you already curious and already using the product. Your job is to turn that curiosity into activated, deeply adopted teams — and to ensure the motion that lets the next ten people do it after you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Lead Enterprise onboarding, pilots, and rollouts end to end — setup, admin training, then adoption team by team: usage reviews with admins and chasing the pockets that haven’t linked calendars.
* Serve as the primary contact for inbound support and agent\-behavior feedback via email and Slack.
* Handle churn with a real save motion: understand why, offer the right landing spot, and harvest the reason.
* Build the machine: usage and retention reporting, templates, runbooks, and the QA loop behind our AI support agent.

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* **Accounts activate.** Within 90 days of close, most of an account’s users clear the value bar — five or more meetings scheduled. Account activation rate is the number you own.
* **Activation sticks.** Users hold that bar on a trailing 90\-day basis. First\-time activation is the start; sustained usage is the proof a team has actually changed how it schedules.
* **The product gets better.** A third of what customers write to us is a bug, a sixth a feature request. You turn that stream into prioritized input for product and engineering.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* 3\+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions. Founding or first\-CS\-hire experience is a strong plus.
* Technically curious and unafraid of the stack — you can hold your own with engineers.
* Comfortable with data and quick to learn. You know the difference between a number and a story.
* Commercially aware: you’ve read an account, known when it was ready to grow, and made the case with evidence rather than instinct.
* Exceptional writer — most of this job happens in email and Slack, in front of managing partners and heads of platform at some of the best firms in the world.
* Organized to a fault, with high agency and no ego about scope. Fifteen external calls, forty email threads, a bug queue, and a pilot scorecard only coexist if you have a system — and some weeks the job is a training session, some weeks a supplier registration portal at 9pm.
* Bonus: experience with horizontal productivity tools, or a network in venture capital, private equity, or professional services.

new_jobs.title: Manager 2, Data Science - Intuit Customer Success
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).
* Lead and develop a world\-class team of analysts and data scientists, coaching technical and strategic skill sets, especially in advanced analytics, applied data science, and modeling.
* Translate business and analytics strategies into multiple short\-term and long\-term projects, and manage end\-to\-end execution, including the creation of a metric framework for expert experiences and developing learning plans that connect training and service investments to expert experience metrics.
* Activate analytics insights that lead to decisions or better hypotheses, and evangelize innovative analytics ideas that enable new opportunities.
* Drive analytics rigor by inspecting and improving experimentation methodologies and techniques, and creating a learning culture.
* Drive the data roadmap from data quality to data visualization, and construct data models that enable E2E service excellence measurement.
* Role\-model "win\-together" while challenging the status quo and driving change across teams, regardless of organizational structure.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of diverse analytics and data science experience, including product analytics and customer/expert experience analytics.
* Proven experience leading a team of analysts and/or scientists.
* Strong passion for uncovering strategic opportunities and solving business problems.
* Prior hands\-on experience with advanced statistical analysis, controlled experimentation (including A/B testing of hierarchical mixed effects), and applied data science.
* Prior hands\-on experience with Causal Inference methods (Propensity Score, DiD, Synthetic Control, etc.) and knowing when to use them to answer key business questions.
* Experience designing quality and experience metrics (e.g., NPS\-style scores, quality scorecards) and connecting them to business KPIs such as conversion and service time.
* Proficient with SQL and Python.
* Experience applying AI/ML and GenAI tools to accelerate analysis and workflows.
* Experience with data gap assessments, requirements gathering, and infrastructure implementation.

The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health, and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York's most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  

* Serve as a point of contact for al front\-end MFV customer service interactions, maintaining high\-quality care and effectively routing inquiries.

* Provide customer care services through phone and in\-person interactions regarding mobile food vending permits and licenses, including guiding customers on required documentation.
* Assist in logistical planning and execution of operations, including scheduling appointments for Mobile Food Vendors pre\-permit inspections, and inventory control.

* Address inquiries from the Bureau’s Health \& Safety Coordinator and maintain compliance with health and safety regulations.

* Support the Bureau’s Project Support Specialist with updates on vehicle usage and documentation.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Procurement Coordinator to monitor supplies and report any IT or resource issues.
* Assist with additional administrative duties and special projects as assigned to support the program.

  

PREFERRED SKILLS:
  

* Excellent communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Excellent decision making and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office
* Bilingual

o a premium\-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
  

o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
  

o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
  

o a tax\-deferred savings program and
  

o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
  

* Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.

\- Job Security \- you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.
  

  

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti\-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. Ready to make a difference? Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together**


The Clinical Administrative Coordinator is an integral member of the NY MAP (New York Medicaid Advantage Plus) \& NYLTSS (New York Long Term Services and Supports) clinical team, providing the administrative support necessary to ensure that enrollees and members receive their Long\-Term Services and Supports (LTSS). Working closely with Care Managers (CMs) and CM Managers, this role serves as a key operational resource \- triaging calls, coordinating with LTSS vendors, maintaining accurate clinical documentation, and monitoring eligibility and assessment data in New York State systems. This is a high\-volume, service\-oriented environment that requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to excellence in supporting vulnerable Medicaid populations.


This position is full\-time (40 hours/week) Monday \- Friday from 8:30 AM \- 5:00 PM. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.


If you are in New York state, you will have the flexibility to telecommute\* as you take on some tough challenges.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Administrative Support to the Clinical Team**

* Serve as an integral administrative partner to the NY MAP \& NYLTSS clinical team, providing day\-to\-day operational support to Care Managers and CM Managers to facilitate seamless delivery of LTSS to members
* Ensure required internal clinical documentation is accurately saved in each member's record; identify and report any documentation gaps or missing records to the appropriate clinical staff in a timely manner
* Review, organize, and disseminate Excel\-based reports to CM staff as needed to support care management workflows, caseload monitoring, and compliance tracking

**Member \& Provider Call Triage and Escalation**

* Triage inbound calls and requests from NY MAP \& NYLTSS enrollees, family members/caregivers, and LTSS providers, accurately assessing the nature and urgency of each inquiry
* Escalate member and provider issues to the assigned Care Manager or CM Manager in accordance with established NY MAP \& NYLTSS protocols, ensuring warm handoffs and complete documentation of the concern
* Document all interactions thoroughly within the care management system, maintaining HIPAA compliance and adherence to NY MAP \& NYLTSS record\-keeping requirements

**LTSS Vendor Coordination \& Service Gap Management**

* Collaborate with contracted LTSS vendors \- including home care agencies, personal care providers, adult day health programs, and other community\-based service organizations \- to confirm that authorized services are in place and being delivered to members
* Identify and communicate service gaps or initiation delays to the assigned Care Manager for timely resolution, ensuring members do not experience interruptions in their authorized LTSS
* Track and document vendor follow\-up activities, maintaining a clear record of service status and outreach efforts within the care management platform

**Eligibility \& Assessment Review in NYS Systems**

* Review member Medicaid eligibility status in New York State systems (e.g., ePACES) and flag any lapses, pending renewals, or changes that may impact LTSS service continuity
* Monitor assessment completion status in NYS systems (e.g., UAS\-NY), ensuring that required assessments are current and coordinating with Care Managers when follow\-up is needed
* Report eligibility and assessment discrepancies to the clinical team and escalate to the CM Manager as appropriate to maintain compliance with NYSDOH MLTC/MAP \& NYLTSS requirements


This is a high\-volume, service\-oriented environment. You will need to be efficient, productive, and thorough in supporting NY MAP \& NYLTSS members and the clinical team. You must be able to work a flexible schedule that may include evening hours. You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you, give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, and provide development opportunities for other roles you may be interested in.


You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

* High School Diploma/GED
* 2\+ years of customer service experience
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Word (create, edit, and save documents), Microsoft Excel (create, edit, and save spreadsheets), and Microsoft Outlook (email and calendar management)
* Must reside in New York State
* Required to have a dedicated work area established that is separated from other living areas and provides information privacy
* Must live in a location that can receive a UnitedHealth Group approved high\-speed internet connection or leverage an existing high\-speed internet service

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within the health care industry and with health care insurance, particularly in a Medicaid, MLTC, or Managed Care environment
* Familiarity with New York State Medicaid systems including ePACES and UAS\-NY
* Experience working with LTSS vendors, home care agencies, or community\-based service providers
* Clerical or administrative support background in a clinical or managed care setting
* Knowledge of ICD\-10 and CPT codes
* Experience working in a call center or high\-volume telephonic environment

Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused SaaS Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.


In this role, you’ll serve as the primary commercial point of contact for your assigned accounts. You will build trusted customer relationships, understand each organization’s goals and AI strategy, increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and proactively address risks that could affect the customer experience or commercial relationship.

  

You’ll be responsible for developing and executing account plans, managing a healthy expansion pipeline, and coordinating internal teams to resolve customer needs. This includes identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across relevant products, features, use cases, and services.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager, Hospitality
new_jobs.description:
**About Ande**  

We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  

We’re looking for an Account Manager to join the Supply team to support client success after they go live. That means retention, growth, and the kind of relationship that makes operators choose Ande for every new location and every new initiative. You'll sit at the intersection of revenue and relationship, monitoring health signals, running strategic reviews, and building the trust that converts a live account into a long\-term, expanding partner. You are the operator's advocate, their data interpreter, and the first person to know when something is off, or when there's an opportunity worth chasing.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the post\-live revenue relationship: manage adoption, retention, and growth across an assigned book of accounts, with accountability for product usage, Net Revenue Retention, churn, and expansion
* Execute a segmented coverage model, calibrating your time and depth of engagement to revenue impact across your book
* Run proactive lifecycle management: show up before operators know they need you, at the right moments in the account lifecycle, with the right context, before friction has a chance to settle in
* Monitor and interpret product signals: track leading indicators across usage, adoption, and revenue to identify at\-risk patterns before they become churn events
* Translate what you see in the data into a clear narrative, for the operator and for your internal team
* Drive expansion in partnership with Sales: surface upsell and expansion signals early, before the operator asks and before the AE has to chase, and bring the context that makes the handoff worth acting on
* Build champions who understand the value Ande is delivering and are willing to say so

**What We're Looking For**

* 3\-6 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client\-facing revenue role
* Someone who wants to work in an AI\-first environment, who actively looks for ways to use it to do better work, move faster, and show up sharper for their accounts
* Experience managing a tiered book of business with multiple account types, coverage models, and competing priorities at once
* Comfort with data; you know how to pull signals from a dashboard, translate them into a coherent narrative, and take action proactively
* A genuine bias toward proactive outreach over reactive firefighting; you're already thinking about the next touchpoint before the last one ends
* Cross\-functional fluency; you know how to work with Sales, Product, and leadership without dropping the ball or losing the relationship thread
* Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, MixMax, Claude, G\-Suite, etc., and a general comfort picking up new tools quickly

**Bonus Points**

* You've worked in hospitality, restaurant tech, or payments; you understand the operational rhythms of a venue and what actually moves operator behavior

In this role, you’ll serve as the primary commercial point of contact for your assigned accounts. You will build trusted customer relationships, understand each organization’s goals and AI strategy, increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and proactively address risks that could affect the customer experience or commercial relationship.

  

You’ll be responsible for developing and executing account plans, managing a healthy expansion pipeline, and coordinating internal teams to resolve customer needs. This includes identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across relevant products, features, use cases, and services.

  

This role is ideal for someone who combines consultative selling skills with strong account management, commercial judgment, and a genuine interest in helping customers realize measurable value from AI.

  

Responsibilities:

  

Account Ownership and Customer Relationships

* Partner with relevant sales teams when an opportunity requires additional commercial or technical expertise.

Adoption, Retention, and Risk Management

* Help customers maximize the value they receive from the company’s products and services.
* Proactively identify accounts with low adoption, limited engagement, unresolved issues, or potential churn risk.
* Develop clear action plans to improve adoption, rebuild engagement, and protect the long\-term customer relationship.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products and use cases that support the customer’s evolving business objectives.

Customer Issue Coordination

* Take ownership of the customer experience when commercial, billing, product, contractual, or operational issues arise.
* Assess customer concerns, determine their business impact, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.

* Escalate high\-impact or time\-sensitive issues through the correct internal channels.
* Ensure customer concerns are followed through to resolution while maintaining trust and accountability.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements that can reduce customer friction.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Renewals, Customer Success, Support, Solutions, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations teams.
* Coordinate internal resources to deliver consistent and seamless customer experience.
* Ensure clear handoffs, ownership, and accountability when multiple teams are involved in an account.
* Share customer insights and commercial opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Contribute to team best practices, enablement sessions, account reviews, and continuous process improvement.


CRM and Operational Excellence

* Keep expansion opportunities, pipeline stages, close dates, and forecasts current and reliable.

new_jobs.title: Development Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**How you move is why we’re here. ®**  

**Now more than ever.**

  

Get back to what you need and love to do.
  

The possibilities are endless...
  

  

Now more than ever, our guiding principles are helping us in our search for exceptional talent \- candidates who align with our unique workplace culture and who want to maximize the abundant opportunities for growth and success.
  

  

If this describes you then let’s talk!
  

  

HSS is consistently among the top\-ranked hospitals for orthopedics and rheumatology by U.S. News \& World Report. As a recipient of the Magnet Award for Nursing Excellence, HSS was the first hospital in New York City to receive the distinguished designation. Whether you are early in your career or an expert in your field, you will find HSS an innovative, supportive and inclusive environment.  



  

Working with colleagues who love what they do and are deeply committed to our Mission, you too can be part of our transformation across the enterprise.


**Emp Status**

Regular Full time
**Work Shift**

**Compensation Range**

The base pay scale for this position is $50,000\.00 \- $76,250\.00\. In addition, this position will be eligible for additional benefits consistent with the role. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be determined based on various factors, including but not limited to: scope of role, level of experience, education, accomplishments, internal equity, budget, and subject to Fair Market Value evaluation. The hiring range listed is a good faith determination of potential compensation at the time of this job advertisement and may be modified in the future.
**What you will be doing**
==========================

**DUTIES AND Responsibilities**

* Maintains overall database integrity, with emphasis on demographic management (data entry, data clean\-up, returned mail, address corrections, duplicate resolution, etc.)
* Processes all contributions in Raiser's Edge 7/NXT, including high\-volume gift entry via Omatic. Verifies biographical information and creates new records as required
* Produces acknowledgment letters and tax documentation for contributions to the Foundation using MS Word and MS Excel mail merge. Also responsible for proofing letters in a timely and accurate fashion to adhere to Foundation’s 48\-hour turnaround acknowledgment policy
* Maintains efficient and comprehensive files of all gifts, supporting documentation and acknowledgments
* Generates and distributes contribution reports
* Completes database projects and other development projects as assigned
* Consistently meets expectations set by Development Operations on an ongoing basis while maintaining high levels of customer service and accuracy
* Participates in training and informational sessions on best practices for gift and record procedures

**EXPERIENCE, COMPETENCIES, AND PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS** **:**

* One to three years of experience with processing database records preferred. Raiser’s Edge or fundraising database experience highly desirable
* Participates in training and informational sessions on best practices for gift and record procedures
* Well organized, meticulously detail\-oriented, and resourceful self\-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
* Technologically savvy. Advanced proficiency in MS Office Suite and comfortable working in database systems
* Fast and accurate keyboarding skills
* Ability to learn complex data entry codes and procedures quickly
* Strong interpersonal skills; success at cultivating strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and creating partnerships
* Smart, reliable and unquestionable personal integrity
* Confidence and commitment, with the drive and energy to respond to the demands of the institution and work collaboratively to achieve results
* Ability to anticipate needs, see opportunities and use good judgment in dealing with confidential information

**EDUCATION:**

* A bachelor’s degree is required.

**Non\-Discrimination Policy**  

Hospital for Special Surgery is committed to providing high quality care and skilled, compassionate, reliable service to our community in a safe and healing environment. Consistent with this commitment, Hospital for Special Surgery provides care, admits, and treats patients and provides all services without regard to age, race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, national origin, culture, language, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic status, veteran or military status, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law or by accreditation standards.

new_jobs.title: Solar Sales Representatives & Solar Sales Teams Epc model
new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking energetic and motivated Solar Sales Representatives and Solar Sales Teams to drive growth within our innovative EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) solar energy model. In this dynamic role, you will be the frontline ambassador for solar energy solutions, engaging with potential clients to educate, inspire, and close sales. Your enthusiasm for renewable energy combined with your sales expertise will help accelerate the adoption of clean energy while building a rewarding career. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on sustainable development and expand your professional skills in a fast\-paced industry.

**Duties**

* Actively generate leads through door\-to\-door outreach, community events, and strategic marketing initiatives to identify potential customers interested in solar energy solutions
* Conduct comprehensive client consultations to explain the benefits of solar panels, energy savings, and the EPC process, ensuring clear understanding of technical aspects
* Build strong relationships with clients by providing exceptional customer service, answering questions, and addressing concerns promptly and professionally
* Negotiate terms and close deals efficiently by leveraging sales techniques such as active listening, value proposition articulation, and overcoming objections
* Utilize CRM (Customer Relationship Management) software like Salesforce to track leads, manage customer interactions, and monitor sales progress
* Collaborate with marketing teams to develop targeted campaigns that attract new clients and increase brand awareness in local communities
* Meet or exceed sales goals consistently by proactively managing your pipeline and following up on potential opportunities

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in outside sales, direct sales, or technical sales within the renewable energy or energy solutions industry is highly preferred
* Strong knowledge of solar energy products, energy savings benefits, and the EPC model for solar installations
* Excellent negotiation skills coupled with the ability to close deals effectively while maintaining customer satisfaction
* Multilingual or bilingual abilities are a plus for engaging diverse client bases
* Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce or similar CRM software for lead management and reporting
* Exceptional communication skills for client engagement, presentations, and negotiations
* Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets consistently in a fast\-paced environment
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within assigned territories for face\-to\-face client meetings
* Leadership qualities that inspire team collaboration and drive collective success

Join us if you’re passionate about renewable energy and eager to grow your career in a vibrant industry. We value proactive individuals who thrive on challenge and are committed to making a positive environmental impact through innovative solar solutions. This is a paid position designed for motivated professionals ready to lead the charge toward a sustainable future!

**Apply for this job here** https://samaritansolar.customcoded.pro/careers/solar\-sales\-representatives\-solar\-sales\-teams\-epc\-model\-2?src\=indeed

Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $250,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10004

new_jobs.title: Social Media and Community Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Social Media and Community Manager** 

**About Our Client**

We’re a luxury skincare brand, devoted to targeted skincare solutions that address how skin cells age and how best to protect and revitalize the complexion and skin microbiome. Our products are sold direct to consumer via our brand website, Amazon, and at specialty retailers and spas, globally.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Social \& Community Manager to join our Marketing team and help build, engage, and nurture the communities that have formed around our brand. Reporting to management, you'll be voice of our social presence, creating meaningful content and a natural relationship builder who thrives in fast\-paced environments with a genuine passion for social media and connecting with people.

This pivotal role is perfect for someone who is eager to join an established, but small luxury skincare brand, helping to envision new and creative ways to engage, educate and inspire people about our unique products, and approach to healthy skin.

**What You'll Do**

* Content Creation and Social Media Support: Stay plugged into emerging trends and adapt / develop content quickly to capitalize on new opportunities
* Experience managing creators and partnerships, identifying and cultivating a selective community of creators (including dermatologists, aestheticians, and luxury lifestyle voices).
* Manage the creation \& posting of engaging, on\-brand content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, writing compelling captions and copy that reflect brand voice and drive engagement
* Build 30–60\-day content calendars aligned to product launches, skincare seasons, holidays, and cultural moments relevant to a luxury skincare audience; Use content scheduling and management tools such as Later, Sprout Social, or similar platforms. Collaborate cross\-functionally with creative, marketing, and product teams to align social content with broader campaign initiatives.
* Shoot and edit short\-form video content optimized for Reels, TikToks, and Stories
* Basic proficiency in editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or similar apps
* Reporting (weekly/monthly/YTD): Track and analyze social performance metrics and creator content performance against partnership investment in order to regularly optimize engagement, reach, and overall social presence.
* Reactively engage with users on tagged posts, comments, and mentions across all social platforms (collaborating with customer care as needed)
* Monitor and engage in general skincare, health/wellness and trending conversations where the brand can organically insert its voice
* Conduct ongoing social media research to identify how target audiences are discovering and engaging with luxury brands, \& content while building awareness of algorithm changes in reach and visibility.
* Create and execute strategies that grow and optimize the Affiliate Program (Impact, LTK, ShopMy, YouTube), supporting creator community, as well as select loyalty partners. Negotiate commissions, performance goals, and generate program reports (monthly/YTD).

**What You'll Bring**

* 3\-5 years of social media and community management experience, ideally with beauty, skincare, or luxury lifestyle focus.
* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a warm, authentic voice
* Strong multitasking abilities and comfort working independently across multiple platforms
* Proven relationship\-building skills and genuine enjoyment of connecting with people
* Experience in scrappy, fast\-moving startup environments
* Deep understanding of social media platforms and community dynamics
* Experience with analytics tools beyond platform tools, as well as scheduling, and creative organizational tools.
* You are an excellent communicator — a good listener who can empathize with our users, manage user feedback, be responsive, and oﬀer support so that we can improve the user experience for our community.
* Some experience in content creation (photography, graphics, video, and editorial/ visual skills) and scheduling content on multiple platforms
* Must have a basic understanding of editing social first content
* Passion for beauty, skincare and enthusiasm for learning on the job.
* Are a fluent English speaker and writer

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistent growth in community size and engagement across all platforms
* Positive social sentiment and strong brand perception
* Improved content engagement metrics over time
* Build/Deepen relationships between the brand and our most loyal customers
* Timely and effective resolution of community issues in partnership with the Customer Service team

**Tools \& Tech Skills**

Social medial platform tools: Meta business suite, TikTok Creator, YouTube Studio)

Content \& Calendar Management: i.e., Later, Sprout or similar tools.

Analytics tools: Platform analytics, Google Analytics, and ability to train on new platforms.

Design/Production: Proficiency/Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or similar apps

**Compensation**

Base Salary: $65k \- $90k \- Commensurate with experience.

Performance Bonus: This role is eligible for an annual bonus

Health, dental, \& vision: Employer contributed

Free Product Allowance: Quarterly allowance

Vacation Days

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
**Role Overview:**


We are looking for a creative, platform\-native **Social Media Manager** to help create, edit, and publish engaging content across our social channels. This is a 100% remote, paid internship requiring 5–12 hours per week. You will work directly with our team to bring our brand story to life, with a heavy focus on short\-form video.

  


**What You'll Do**


* Content Creation: Create fun engaging AI Videos promoting our company using Capcut AI
* Platform Management: Plan and schedule posts using management tools (e.g., Later, Buffer, Hootsuite) to maintain a consistent posting calendar.
* Trend Spotting: Monitor social media trends, viral audio, and format updates to keep our content fresh and relevant.
* Engagement: Respond to comments, engage with our community, and monitor direct messages.

  




**What We're Looking For**


* Editing Skills: Proficiency in mobile editing apps like **CapCut, In Shot, or Adobe Premiere Rush, and design tools like Canva.**
* Self\-Starter: Ability to work independently in a remote environment, meet deadlines, and communicate effectively via Slack/email.
* Portfolio Required: Examples of your own content creation (personal or professional) that showcase your video editing and storytelling skills.

  




**Compensation \& Commitment**

  



* Pay: $20\-30 hr. (NY/NJ Market)
* Hours: 5–12 hours per week with a flexible schedule
* Location: 100% Remote.

Title: Sales Representative II (Albany, Capital City Region)  



Location: Statewide Multi Use, NY  



Job Requisition ID: Req\-271790  



Time Type: Full time  



  

**About Lamb Weston**

  

You’ve probably enjoyed our fries without even knowing it! As a leading manufacturer in our industry, we inspire and bring people together with foods they love and trust. Our customer base includes international food service providers, restaurants, and households in over 100 countries around the world.

  

A highly innovative global corporation with a start\-up mindset, we empower every individual to make a genuine difference. You’ll gain access to hands\-on training to fuel your growth and success, explore opportunities for new solutions, and you’ll join a winning team of 10,000\+ people all dedicated to raising the bar – together.

  

If you have a strong drive for results, a desire to help us bring the world together through our fries, and are ready for a fresh challenge, we want to hear from you.

**Job Description Summary**

  



A Sales Representative will contribute to the Lamb Weston sales team by securing and maintaining accounts within an identified territory or region. Sales Representatives work with functional sales partners to leverage analytics and insights, and to contribute to customized category goals, strategies, and tactics to achieve sales growth objectives for assigned customers and development of new business – new customers. Sales representatives contribute to delivering/exceeding the company sales and profit goals.**Job Description**

**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:**

* Takes national and zone strategies and develops/applies sales strategies to assigned accounts in designated territory or region and to new/developing business.
* Prepares and delivers presentations by compiling information from internal/external sources.
* Understands the segments in which Lamb Weston customers operate and the unique challenges to each.
* Understands the financial implications of decisions on the customer and the company.
* Ensures the success of new products through targeted sales strategies and product launches.
* Identifies and shares best practices for Lamb Weston.
* Conducts gap/opportunity analysis with costing implications using basic financial measures.
* Anticipates and addresses execution issues/objectives before they become a problem.
* Interacts with cross functional teams within Lamb Weston and at assigned distribution accounts.
* Interfaces across functions at the customer to develop mutually beneficial programs and solutions.
* Understands product portfolio tactics and how they are used achieve company objectives.
* Take responsibility for individual development including, but not limited to: on\-boarding, sales training, sales skills and tools training, and team training.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Basic \& Preferred Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Business Administration or related field preferred.
* Experience: Sales Representative 1 – 1 to 2 years of related sales experience; Sales Representative 2 – 3 to 4 years sales experience; Sales Representative 3 – 4\+ year’s sales experience. Or suitable combination of education and experience.
* Computer Skills: Ability to use a variety of technologies and tools including, Microsoft Suite, CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce.com, Tibersoft, DOMO, PROs).
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills and ability to negotiate. Ability to read, write and speak in English required. Bilingual/Multilingual skills desirable.
* Strong business management skills, including financial management skills and a strategic mindset.
* The ability to travel independently, valid U.S. drivers’ license, and ability to meet Company driving standards.
* Travel up to 15% (local with occasional overnight).

**Industry\-Competitive Benefits**


Coupled with our compensation and bonus incentive programs, our benefits deliver rewards that are market competitive. Some of the most attractive elements of our benefit programs include:

* Health Insurance Benefits \- Medical, Dental, Vision
* Flexible Spending Accounts for Health and Dependent Care, and Health Reimbursement Accounts
* Well\-being programs including companywide events and a wellness incentive program
* Paid Time Off
* Financial Wellness – Industry leading 401(k) plan with generous company contributions, Financial Planning Services, Employee Stock purchase program, and Health Savings Accounts, Life and Accident insurance
* Family\-Friendly Employee events
* Employee Assistance Program services – mental health and other concierge type services


Benefits may vary based on location, job role/level, job status, and/or the terms of any applicable collective bargaining agreements.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree (business or professional selling preferred)
* Must be authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for sponsorship.
* Experience in B2B sales, handling complex processes and facilitating several touchpoints over multiple channels

**Sales Benefits**

* the industry’s most competitive sales commission jobs with uncapped earning potential
* health insurance at $1 per pay period for employees
* 401(k) with company match
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* transportation allowance
* paid vacation, sick, bereavement, holiday and personal days
* paid family leave
* award\-winning learning and development programs
* President’s Club: annual five\-star retreat for the year’s top performers

Paycom is a publicly traded, industry\-leading HR and payroll tech company. **Junior Account Manager – Liquidity Management \& Treasury Advisory**

Location: Atlanta, Georgia (Midtown / Buckhead business district)

Employment Type: Full\-time, permanent, benefits\-eligible (at\-will)

Work Model: Hybrid – flexible in\-office and remote schedule

Compensation: $4,100 – $5,200 gross per month (approx. $49,200 – $62,400 annual base) \+ annual performance bonus (up to 15%)

Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

**About the Role**

We are a specialized business consulting firm focused on liquidity management, corporate treasury, cash flow optimization, working capital, and financial advisory. Our Atlanta team is growing, and we are looking for a Junior Account Manager to support our client relationships and consulting projects across the region.

This is a client\-facing role at the intersection of financial consulting and account management. You will work alongside senior consultants and treasury advisors, serving industrial companies, commercial enterprises, financial institutions, and investment funds. If you are early in your career and eager to build deep expertise in liquidity management while developing strong client relationship skills, this position offers a structured path forward.

You will report to a Senior Account Manager and collaborate daily with teams in Financial Consulting, Treasury Advisory, Compliance, Data Analytics, and Customer Success.

**What You'll Do**

Client Portfolio Assistance

Partner with the Senior Account Manager to oversee a portfolio of domestic and international clients. Handle day\-to\-day operational tasks, administrative coordination, and routine reporting to keep accounts running smoothly.

Client Communication \& Support

Act as the initial point of contact for client inquiries related to our liquidity management services — including cash forecasting, working capital optimization, cash flow management, and treasury operations. Ensure every response is prompt, professional, and accurate.

Consulting Project Collaboration

Work with senior consultants to gather and analyze client financial data. Help prepare reports, executive\-level presentations, and commercial proposals. Track project milestones and flag any issues that need attention.

Client Onboarding

Guide new clients through the early stages of our relationship. Provide clear information about our services, collect required documentation, and help coordinate a smooth project kickoff.

Reporting \& Analysis

Produce regular reports covering portfolio performance, project KPIs, liquidity metrics, and client satisfaction. Use CRM platforms and advanced spreadsheet tools to compile and present data.

Target Contribution

Support the team in meeting retention goals, customer satisfaction (CSAT) targets, upselling objectives, and overall portfolio growth.

**What We're Looking For**

Education \& Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Political Science, or a related discipline.

0–2 years of professional experience in account management, customer success, commercial support, administrative coordination, or analytical roles. Relevant internship experience in consulting, corporate finance, treasury, or private banking is highly valued.

Exposure to consulting firms, professional services, banking, fintech, treasury departments, or financial sector organizations is a plus.

**Technical Skills**

Comfortable with Microsoft Office, especially Excel for financial data work and reporting.

Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Ability to produce professional documents — reports, presentations, and client proposals.

Basic understanding of liquidity management concepts (cash flow, working capital, treasury, banking relationships) is a strong advantage.

**Languages**

Proficiency in additional languages is highly welcomed and will be considered a valuable asset. Our firm serves international clients and operates with global consulting methodologies, so the ability to communicate in languages such as Italian, Spanish, French, or German will support your work with cross\-border clients and international projects. English fluency is required for all internal and client\-facing communication.

**Soft Skills**

Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, with a focus on active listening and empathy.

Detail\-oriented, organized, and capable of juggling multiple priorities.

Proactive and intellectually curious, with a genuine desire to learn and grow.

Effective problem\-solver who can translate complex client needs into actionable steps.

Collaborative team player who adapts well to a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward performance and support long\-term growth.

Base Salary: $4,100 – $5,200 gross per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Performance Bonus: Annual MBO bonus of up to 15%, tied to individual and team results.

Retirement: 401(k) plan with employer contributions.

Time Off: Paid time off and company holidays.

Commuter Support: Parking allowance, transit reimbursement, or commuter benefits.

Work\-Life Balance: Hybrid schedule with flexible hours and a collaborative, digitally enabled work environment.

Professional Development: Structured onboarding, mentorship from a senior colleague, access to training platforms covering financial consulting, liquidity management, corporate treasury, and soft skills. Individual training budget and support for certifications such as CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) or courses in cash management and working capital.

Workplace Perks: Modern office space in Atlanta's business district with coworking areas, relaxation spaces, periodic team\-building events, wellness program, gym discounts, and a culture built on transparenc

new_jobs.title: Travel Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**We Put the World on Vacation**


Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. **This is a fully virtual work from home sales position for candidates who reside in the states of Florida, Georgia and South Carolina only. Candidates who reside outside of these states will not be considered.** Successful candidates must be able to meet our work at home requirements (see below).

**How You'll Shine:**


Are you passionate about travel and skilled in sales? Join our team as a Travel Sales Representative with Travel \+ Leisure! In this role, you’ll combine your love for customer service with your sales expertise to create unforgettable travel experiences for our clients. Here’s what you’ll do:

**Sales and Customer Service:** Take inbound calls from excited customers ready to plan their dream vacations. Your expertise will guide them through the booking process for car rentals, airfare, hotel reservations, cruises and local experiences.

**Subject Matter Expertise:** As a **Travel Sales Representative,** you’ll be the go\-to resource for our customers. Build rapport and recommend personalized, lifestyle\-aligned travel solutions—air, hotel, cruise, car, and local experiences—curated for each customer.

* **$17\.50 per hour plus monthly sales incentives based off your performance**
* **Start Date: Friday October 16th**

**What You'll Bring:**

* **Proven Sales Experience:** Demonstrated success in driving results through inbound service, outbound follow\-up, and relationship\-based selling.
* **Exceptional Interpersonal Skills:** Quickly establish rapport with customers, engage in meaningful conversations, and create lasting connections. You’ll ask probing questions to understand their travel needs and seamlessly offer additional services.
* **Strong Multitasking Abilities:** Thrive under pressure and handle multiple tasks effectively.
* **Education Requirement:** High School Diploma or GED is required.
* **Customer Service and Sales Experience:** Six months of experience in both areas.
* **Travel Experience Preferred:** Six months of travel\-related experience is a plus.
* **Technology Agility:** Comfortable managing several technology applications simultaneously (CRM, booking tools, payment systems, communication apps). Prior travel software knowledge (e.g., Amadeus, Apollo, Sabre, Worldspan) is helpful but not required; ability to learn quickly is essential.
* **Training Schedule:** A 5\-week training schedule from 11:00 am to 8:00 pm EST.
* **Post\-Training Availability:** Be available to work between 8:00 am and 10:00 pm EST Monday to Saturday with a set schedule provided.
* **Holiday Availability:** Ability to work some holidays.

**What is required for me to work from home?**

* Quiet workplace free of distractions and background noise
* High speed internet requirements Download speed of 20 mbps and upload speed of 3 mbps average ping below 100m
* Must be able to hardwire computer directly to a router
* Must have own personal device with a working camera to be used for the first week of training (until our computers reach your home)
* Intermediate computer proficiency and ability to troubleshoot technical issues while at home

**So what are you waiting for? Apply today to start your next career journey with Travel \& Leisure—where you’ll deliver not just trips, but unforgettable, concierge\-level experiences for every customer!**

 **How You'll Be Rewarded:**


We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include:


***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.***

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life and accident coverage
* Disability
* Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
* 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Legal and identify theft plan
* Voluntary income protection benefits
* Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
* Employee Assistance Program

 **Where Memories Start with You**


Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who we are**



Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Our Mid\-Market Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long\-term partner.



You'll manage a portfolio of 100\-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid\-Market your reach and prioritize where you spend your time. You won't shy away from rolling up your sleeves on integrations and the more technical aspects of the Samsara platform — you'll learn, understand, and convey the value of our most complex products and features.



Your role will be cross\-functional, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper\-growth company from within. The Mid\-Market CS team is still being built, and you'll help write its next chapter — shaping the playbooks, workflows, and AI\-powered motions that define how we Mid\-Market.


**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.**  


**You should apply if:**
* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
* **You thrive the most when solving problems:** Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
* **You are a natural relationship builder:** Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross\-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.


**In this role, you will:**
* Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
* Manage a portfolio of \~100\-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid\-Market your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
* Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non\-technical audience and to engage the right cross\-functional partners to drive resolution.
* Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.
* Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
* Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities — including its more technical and integration\-related features — and explain them to businesses of all types: field services, utilities, long\-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
* Help build the next chapter of Mid\-Market CS at Samsara by contributing to the playbooks, workflows, and AI\-powered motions that define how the team Mid\-Markets.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.


**Minimum requirements for the role:**
* 2 \- 4\+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, sales, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
* This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
* Experience supporting or working with technical products.
* Solutions\-oriented with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety

Substance use disorder continues to be a devastating public health crisis. Americans die from drug overdoses at a rate of roughly 210 to 300 people per day. In 2023, there were 105,007 total drug overdose deaths in the United States. In Illinois, 3052 residents died from an accidental drug overdose in 2023, which is more than twice the number of fatal motor vehicle accidents and more than twice the number of homicides. The increase in the number of fatalities is attributed to the rise of synth3etic opioids, such as fentanyl. Since 2013, synthetic opioid deaths in Illinois have increased 3,341%.

Live4Lali has been serving suburban Chicagoland for nearly sixteen years providing critical prevention, education, treatment access, support programs, community solutions\-building initiatives, risk reduction, and overdose prevention services to decrease the devastating toll of the opioid epidemic. mission is to reduce stigma and prevent substance use disorder among individuals, families, and communities, and minimize the overall health, legal and social harms associated with substance use.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

The Kane/DuPage Counties Outreach Coordinator reports to the Kane/DuPage Counties Program Manager and works collaboratively with other Outreach Coordinators. This role focuses on community\-based outreach to provide education on risk reduction strategies, naloxone, and overdose prevention, while building trusting relationships with people who use substances. The Outreach Coordinator must be bilingual in Spanish and also provides peer\-based support, drawing on lived experience to reduce harms associated with substance use and connect individuals to resources and support.

Under the direct supervision of the Kane/DuPage Counties Program Manager, the Full\-Time (40 hours) Kane/Dupage Counties Outreach Coordinator will be part of the Live4Lali team, engaged in the following activities:

* Core Responsibilities

Identify areas of greatest need across Kane/Dupage Counties on the street and within existing services (such as our Mobile Outreach Program) to connect with participants and distribute risk reduction supplies

Provide peer\-based support to participants through rapport building, recovery coaching, risk reduction–informed interventions, and referrals, using lived experience to support participant\-defined goals and reduce harms associated with substance use.

Assist with stocking, maintaining, and delivering risk reduction inventory

Accurately log and report data collected during outreach.

Provide on the spot training and education in risk reduction, overdose response, and distribute naloxone, the opioid overdose reversal medication across the county

Identify and collaborate with a range of organizations and entities including but not limited to treatment providers, housing providers, social service organizations, healthcare providers, businesses, government agencies, etc to scale up access to naloxone

Develop and implement substance use prevention programs targeted at the community

Develop and deliver professional education and trainings for community members, professionals, students, and the general public on overdose recognition and response, naloxone administration, substance use, and risk reduction practices

Identify, build, and maintain relationships with community resources—including treatment providers, housing programs, social services, food access programs, and other supports—to develop partnerships and serve as referral and warm handoff resources for participants with identified needs

Identify and develop safety plans with participants who are at increased risk of overdose

Assess community needs in collaboration with participants and report to Program Manager to help develop appropriate programs

Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance at all times

Identify and maintain appropriate communication with team regarding issues, observations, and opportunities

Perform other duties as assigned

* Desired Qualifications

The Kane/Dupage Counties Outreach Coordinator must be a person of lived experience preferably with at least 2 years in recovery/remission from substance use disorder. Being bilingual in Spanish is REQUIRED. They will preferably also have a minimum of two years’ relevant work experience in substance use disorder, mental health, public health or social work. This candidate will demonstrate the following qualifications:

Direct service delivery experience in the community social services sector with a demonstrated working knowledge of community\-based programs and community support systems;

Demonstrated ability to establish rapport with a diverse range of clientele including individuals who are actively using substances and living with significant health challenges;

Proficiency in technology, including but not limited to Google Drive, Zoom, Microsoft Office Suite and GoToMeeting;

Demonstrated attention to detail and strong organizational skills;

Demonstrated knowledge in the areas of safer drug use, addictions, safer sex, sex work, HIV/AIDS, hepatitis C, mental health, etc.;

Demonstrated knowledge of social justice, health promotion and public health approaches and models
